items.title: 〈貴金屬盤後〉Fed升息1碼、華許警告通膨仍過高 金價下挫逾1%
items.title_en: <Precious Metals After Hours> Fed hikes 25 bps, Warsh warns inflation still too high, Gold falls over 1%
paras: 美國聯準會(Fed)周三(16日)啟動升息，並暗示未來幾個月還會進一步升息之後，美元應聲上揚，不孳息的黃金則下挫逾1%。

Fed決議出爐後不久，黃金現貨下跌1.2%，報每盎司4240.10美元，盤中稍早曾上揚超過1%、觸及4365.57美元。
美國黃金期貨收高1.3%，報每盎司4387.50美元。


Fed將基準利率調升1碼(25個基點)至3.75-4.00%，這是主席華許(Kevin Warsh)與所有同僚一致的決議，等於坦承川普政府迄今仍無法控制通膨。
在會後記者會上，華許呼應聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)的聲明，承諾Fed將「實現物價穩定」。
獨立金屬交易員Tai Wong表示：「華許的評論被解讀為偏鷹，搭配偏鷹的利率點陣圖，強化市場對Fed將在未來幾次會議進一步升息的看法。這有助於美元走強，短期也將對金屬價格造成壓力。」
Fed宣布決策後，美元兌歐元走升，使黃金對海外買家而言更加昂貴。
美國總統川普的全球進口關稅、美以對伊朗戰爭爆發後帶來的能源衝擊，以及人工智慧(AI)熱潮帶動的資本支出，都讓物價維持高檔，迫使Fed升息。
華許表示：「我們的焦點在於物價穩定這項職責。事實很簡單，通膨仍然過高，而且持續太久。今年夏季的通膨數據並未讓我認為，潛在趨勢已出現實質改善。」
黃金傳統上被視為對抗通膨的避險工具，但利率走高會降低這種不孳息資產的吸引力。
與此同時，布蘭特原油價格周三回落，因有報導披露沙烏地阿拉伯有更多原油貨物經由阿曼出口，緩解市場對中東供應的疑慮。此外，美國原油庫存降幅小於預期，也對油價構成壓力。

現貨白銀下跌1.7%，報每盎司62.57美元。
現貨白金下跌2.3%，報每盎司1735.33美元。
現貨鈀金下跌1.5%，報每盎司1269.95美元。
paras_en: The U.S. Federal Reserve (Fed) on Wednesday (the 16th) kicked off a rate hike and signaled that further hikes may follow in the coming months, sending the dollar higher while non‑yield‑bearing gold slipped more than 1%.

Soon after the Fed decision, spot gold fell 1.2% to $4,240.10 per ounce, after having risen more than 1% earlier in the session to a high of $4,365.57. U.S. gold futures rose 1.3% to $4,387.50 per ounce.

The Fed raised its benchmark rate by one quarter‑point (25 basis points) to a range of 3.75‑4.00%, a decision unanimously supported by Chair Kevin Warsh and all his colleagues, effectively acknowledging that the Trump administration has so far failed to curb inflation.
In the post‑meeting press conference, Warsh echoed the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) statement and pledged that the Fed will "achieve price stability."

Independent metal trader Tai Wong said: "Warsh's comments are being read as hawkish, and together with a hawkish rate‑dot plot they reinforce the market's view that the Fed will raise rates further in upcoming meetings. This supports a stronger dollar and will put short‑term pressure on metal prices."
After the Fed announced its decision, the dollar rose against the euro, making gold more expensive for overseas buyers.
President Trump's global import tariffs, the energy shock from the U.S.–Israel war with Iran, and the AI‑driven surge in capital spending have all kept prices high, forcing the Fed to hike rates.

Warsh said: "Our focus is on the duty of price stability. The fact is simple: inflation remains too high and has persisted for too long. This summer's inflation data did not convince me that a substantive improvement in the underlying trend has emerged."
Gold is traditionally seen as an inflation‑hedge, but higher rates diminish the appeal of this non‑yielding asset.

Meanwhile, Brent crude fell on Wednesday after reports that Saudi Arabia was shipping more oil via Oman, easing concerns about Middle‑East supply. In addition, U.S. crude inventories fell less than expected, adding pressure on oil prices.

items.title: AI資料中心電力需求爆發 亞馬遜砸最高80億美元買發電機 Generac盤後飆逾40%
items.title_en: AI Data Center Power Demand Booms; Amazon Commits Up to $8 Billion for Generac Generators, Shares Surge Over 40% After Hours
paras: 亞馬遜(AMZN-US)周三(16日)宣布與發電設備製造商Generac Holdings(GNRC-US)簽署長期供應協議, 將向Generac採購備用發電機, 以支援旗下資料中心的電力需求。這項合作的潛在付款總額最高可達80億美元, 同時亞馬遜也取得購買Generac股票的認股權證, 消息公布後推升Generac股價, 盤後一度大漲超過40%。
根據Generac提交的監管文件, 亞馬遜旗下Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings取得認股權證, 最多可購買Generac 1,693,745股普通股, 執行價格為每股200.9266美元, 若全部行使, 認購金額約3.4億美元。
其中約307,954股認股權證股份立即歸屬, 其餘股份則將依亞馬遜及其關係企業未來向Generac支付的備用發電機款項, 按照累計付款金額分批歸屬。這意味著亞馬遜最終能夠取得多少Generac股份, 將與未來實際採購規模直接相關。
雙方此次簽署的長期供應協議, 初始訂單涉及2027年及2028年交付的備用發電機, 金額合計約24億美元。若後續採購持續增加, 整體供應協議的付款總額最高可達80億美元。
Generac股價周三正常交易收在175.11美元, 當日僅上漲0.05%, 但在雙方公布合作消息後, 盤後股價一度飆升超過40%, 盤後交易一度突破240美元, 隨後漲幅有所收斂。
亞馬遜此次採購與AI資料中心擴張有直接關聯。隨著生成式AI快速發展, 雲端運算及資料中心對電力需求持續增加, 大型科技公司除了需要取得穩定的電網供電, 也必須配置大型備用發電設備, 以避免電力中斷影響高價值運算設備及AI服務運作。
Generac是全球主要備用發電機製造商之一, 產品涵蓋住宅、商業及工業市場。近年AI資料中心快速擴張, 已使資料中心成為公司重要的成長市場。Generac也持續增加生產能力, 以因應大型資料中心客戶對兆瓦級備用發電設備的需求。
Generac此前曾表示, 資料中心業務的長期成長潛力強勁, 並預估到2028年資料中心相關銷售額可達10億美元。公司近年也投入約2.5億美元擴充產能, 並增加約1,000名員工, 以應付資料中
paras_en: Amazon (AMZN-US) announced on Wednesday (the 16th) that it has signed a long‑term supply agreement with generator maker Generac Holdings (GNRC-US) to purchase backup generators to support the power needs of its data centers. The potential total payment under the deal could reach as much as $8 billion, and Amazon also received warrants to buy Generac stock, which lifted Generac’s share price, spiking more than 40% in after‑hours trading.

According to regulatory filings submitted by Generac, Amazon’s subsidiary Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings obtained warrants to purchase up to 1,693,745 shares of Generac common stock at an exercise price of $200.9266 per share, which would amount to roughly $340 million if fully exercised.

About 307,954 of the warrant shares vest immediately, while the remaining shares will vest in tranches tied to the amount Amazon and its affiliates subsequently pay Generac for backup generators, based on cumulative payments. This means the ultimate number of Generac shares Amazon can acquire will be directly linked to the actual scale of future purchases.

The long‑term supply agreement’s initial orders cover backup generators to be delivered in 2027 and 2028, with a total value of about $2.4 billion. If subsequent purchases continue to grow, the overall contract’s payment ceiling could rise to as much as $8 billion.

Generac’s stock closed on Wednesday’s regular session at $175.11, up only 0.05% on the day, but after the partnership was announced the after‑hours price surged more than 40%, briefly breaking $240 before easing back.

Amazon’s procurement is directly tied to its expansion of AI data centers. As generative AI rapidly advances, cloud computing and data centers are seeing ever‑increasing power demand. Large tech firms not only need reliable grid power but also must equip massive backup generators to avoid outages that could disrupt high‑value computing equipment and AI services.

Generac is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of backup generators, serving residential, commercial and industrial markets. The rapid growth of AI data centers has made the data‑center segment a key growth market for the company, prompting Generac to expand production capacity to meet megawatt‑scale backup power needs of large‑scale data‑center customers.

Generac has previously said that the long‑term growth potential of its data‑center business is strong, projecting data‑center‑related sales to reach $1 billion by 2028. The company has invested roughly $250 million in recent years to expand capacity and added about 1,000 employees to handle the growing data‑center demand.

items.title: 〈能源盤後〉沙烏地增加經阿曼轉運原油 美原油庫存降幅不如預期 油價回落約3%
items.title_en: Energy After-Hours: Saudi Increases Oil Shipments via Oman as US Crude Inventories Fall Short of Expectations, Oil Prices Slip About 3%
paras: 國際油價周三(16日)下跌, 沙烏地阿拉伯透過阿曼增加原油裝船量的消息, 緩解市場對中東供應中斷進一步擴大的疑慮, 同時美國原油庫存降幅小於預期, 汽油與餾分油庫存反而增加, 進一步對油價構成壓力。
布蘭特原油 (Brent)期貨下跌2.92美元, 跌幅2.7%, 收在每桶105.83美元; 美國西德州中級原油(WTI)期貨下跌3.40美元, 跌幅3.2%, 收在每桶102.43美元。兩大基準油價均結束連續兩個交易日上漲走勢。
市場焦點之一是沙烏地阿拉伯正在尋找繞開受干擾出口路線的方式。消息人士透露, 沙烏地國營石油公司沙烏地阿美(Saudi Aramco)正向亞洲煉油商提供更多原油, 並透過阿曼索哈爾港(Sohar)外海進行船對船轉運, 其中包括旗艦級的Arab Light, 以及Arab Medium和Arab Heavy等原油。索哈爾港位於荷姆茲海峽之外, 因此可降低對該戰略水道的直接依賴。
沙烏地阿美近期至少已兩度向亞洲買家提出類似的Arab Medium及Arab Heavy裝船方案。這些安排顯示, 在東西管線遭到無人機攻擊受損後, 沙烏地正增加將波斯灣原油運出並在荷姆茲海峽以外海域轉運的能力。沙烏地阿美並未對相關消息置評。
瑞銀(UBS)分析師Giovanni Staunovo表示, 沙烏地仍能從波斯灣出口原油的消息, 顯示市場對供應中斷可能進一步擴大的擔憂正在減弱。油價前一交易日曾上漲逾3美元, 原因是航運業消息人士透露, 沙烏地紅海出口樞紐延布港(Yanbu)的原油裝船已暫停, 利雅德也取消部分供應歐洲客戶的貨物。
沙烏地東西管線是連接油田與紅海延布港的重要輸油設施, 在荷姆茲海峽航運受到嚴重干擾後, 更成為沙烏地將原油繞道出口的重要通道。該管線遭無人機攻擊後, 沙烏地於周五宣布關閉, 使市場一度擔心全球原油供應進一步收緊。
不過, 沙烏地正透過其他出口方式降低衝擊。能源顧問公司Energy Aspects的衛星追蹤資料顯示, 過去一周沙烏地拉斯坦努拉(Ras Tanura)及朱艾馬(Juaymah)兩座波斯灣碼頭的每日原油裝船量已增加一倍, 約達4百萬桶, 相當於2艘超大型原油運輸船(VLCC)的裝載量。
航運數據公司Kpler的獨立船舶追蹤資料則顯示, 周三有4艘VLCC在拉斯坦努拉裝載原油, 合計運載能力達800萬桶。其他波斯灣產油國也開始增加在荷姆茲海峽以外地點裝載原油的安排, 並租用船舶穿越荷姆茲海峽接駁供應, 部分船舶甚至關閉追蹤訊號。
沙烏地阿拉伯是全球最大原油出口國。由於荷姆茲海峽的航運受到嚴重限制, 延布港原本成為沙烏地重要的原油出口窗口。路透指出, 在目前的衝突之前, 荷姆茲海峽承擔全球約五分之一的石油及液化天然氣供應運輸。
目前荷姆茲海峽的船舶通行量仍遠低於正常水準。初步航運數據顯示, 周二可辨識的船舶通行數僅4艘, 低於前一天的7艘, 也遠低於過去10天平均18艘的水準, 顯示主要能源航道的運輸仍受到嚴重干擾。
美國庫存數據則成為油價另一項壓力來源。美國能源資訊署(EIA)周三公布, 截至上周美國原油庫存僅減少約64萬桶, 明顯低於路透調查分析師預期的減少162萬桶。汽油及餾分油庫存則同步增加, 其中柴油庫存增幅高於預期, 而分析師原先預期汽油庫存將下降。
Again Capital合夥人John Kilduff表示, 庫存數據對油價構成偏空訊號, 因為煉製產品庫存仍能維持甚至小幅增加, 同時原油庫存下降幅度趨於停滯。這顯示美國成品油供應目前並未出現進一步收緊的跡象。
不過, 市場對中東局勢的擔憂並未消失。沙烏地戰機持續攻擊葉門, 受到伊朗支持的胡塞武裝則向沙烏地城市發射無人機及飛彈。胡塞武裝表示, 已對延布發動新一輪攻擊, 使沙烏地西部能源出口設施仍面臨風險。
Citi則認為, 中東局勢近期進一步升級, 將繼續支撐原油及煉製燃料價格。該銀行預期, 在區域外交努力推動下, 荷姆茲海峽可能於2026年第4季重新開放, 但在此之前, 地緣政治風險仍可能讓能源價格維持高檔。
柴油市場尤其受到關注。隨著中東局勢升溫, 柴油已成為全球石油市場最大的擔憂之一, 原因是中東不僅是重要柴油供應來源, 同時也是生產柴油所需特定原油等級的重要供應地區。烏克蘭對俄羅斯煉油廠的攻擊也進一步壓縮全球柴油供應, 推動柴油價格升至紀錄高位。
歐洲柴油基準的gas oil期貨周二創下歷史新高, 美國超低硫柴油期貨也在同日創下紀錄高點。Naga.com市場分析師Frank Walbaum指出, 歐洲已失去大量來自中東的柴油與航空燃油供應, 同時東歐局勢又干擾俄羅斯多座主要煉油廠的產出, 並促使莫斯科限制燃料出口。
俄羅斯政府也決定將針對燃料生產商的柴油出口限制延長至10月底, 《Vedomosti》周二晚間引述兩名未具名消息人士報導稱, 相關限制將繼續實施。Staunovo表示, 除非中東達成和平協議或俄羅斯局勢有所改善, 否則柴油價格預料仍將受到支撐。
整體而言, 沙烏地增加經阿曼轉運原油的安排, 加上美國原油庫存降幅小於預期, 使油價從近期高點回落。然而, 延布出口中斷、荷姆茲海峽航運量低迷、沙烏地與胡塞武裝衝突升溫, 以及全球柴油供應緊張等因素仍使能源市場面臨高度不確定性, 後續油價仍將取決於中東供應恢復速度與地緣政治局勢發展。
paras_en: International oil prices fell on Wednesday (the 16th) as news that Saudi Arabia is increasing oil shipments through Oman eased market concerns about a further expansion of Middle‑East supply disruptions, while US crude inventories declined less than expected and gasoline and distillate stocks actually rose, adding further pressure on prices.
Brent futures dropped $2.92, or 2.7%, to $105.83 a barrel, and US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) futures fell $3.40, or 3.2%, to $102.43 a barrel. Both benchmark prices ended a two‑day winning streak.

One market focus is Saudi Arabia’s search for ways to bypass disrupted export routes. Sources say Saudi state oil company Saudi Aramco is offering more crude to Asian refiners and is using ship‑to‑ship transfers off Oman’s Sohar port, including flagship Arab Light as well as Arab Medium and Arab Heavy grades. Sohar lies outside the Strait of Hormuz, reducing direct reliance on that strategic waterway.

Saudi Aramco has recently made at least two similar Arab Medium and Arab Heavy loading proposals to Asian buyers. The arrangements show that after the east‑west pipeline was damaged by drone attacks, Saudi Arabia is boosting its ability to move Persian Gulf oil out and transfer it offshore of the Hormuz Strait. Saudi Aramco gave no comment on the reports.

UBS analyst Giovanni Staunovo said that the news Saudi Arabia can still export oil from the Persian Gulf indicates waning market worries that supply disruptions could widen further. Prices had risen more than $3 the previous session after shipping sources said loading at Saudi Red Sea hub Yanbu had been halted and Riyadh had cancelled part of its supply to European customers.

The Saudi east‑west pipeline, a key conduit linking fields to the Red Sea’s Yanbu port, became an even more important export bypass after severe shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz. After a drone strike, Saudi Arabia announced the line’s shutdown on Friday, sparking fears of tighter global oil supply.

Nevertheless, Saudi Arabia is mitigating the impact through other export routes. Satellite data from energy consultancy Energy Aspects shows that over the past week loading at the Persian Gulf terminals Ras Tanura and Juaymah doubled to about 4 million barrels a day – roughly the cargo of two VLCCs.

Independent vessel tracking from Kpler indicated that on Wednesday four VLCCs loaded at Ras Tanura, together carrying about 8 million barrels. Other Persian Gulf producers are also increasing loading outside the Hormuz corridor and chartering ships to transit the strait for supply, with some vessels even turning off tracking signals.

Saudi Arabia is the world’s largest crude exporter. Because shipping through the Strait of Hormuz has been severely constrained, Yanbu had become a crucial export window for Saudi oil. Reuters notes that before the current conflict the strait handled roughly one‑fifth of global oil and LNG shipments.

Ship traffic through the strait remains far below normal. Preliminary data showed only four identifiable vessels on Tuesday, down from seven the day before and well below the ten‑day average of 18, indicating that the main energy artery is still heavily disrupted.

US inventory data added another pressure on prices. The Energy Information Administration reported on Wednesday that US crude stocks fell by only about 640,000 barrels last week, far short of analysts’ expectation of a 1.62 million‑barrel draw. Gasoline and distillate stocks rose, with diesel inventories increasing more than forecast and analysts had expected gasoline stocks to fall.

Again Capital partner John Kilduff said the inventory numbers send a bearish signal to oil prices because refined‑product stocks are holding steady or even edging up while crude drawdowns are stalling, suggesting no further tightening in US product supply.

However, market anxiety over the Middle East has not vanished. Saudi warplanes continue striking Yemen, and Iran‑backed Houthi forces are firing drones and missiles at Saudi cities. The Houthis said they have launched a new wave of attacks on Yanbu, keeping Saudi western export facilities at risk.

Citi believes that a further escalation of Middle‑East tensions will continue to support crude and refined‑fuel prices. The bank projects that, with diplomatic efforts, the Strait of Hormuz could reopen in Q4 2026, but geopolitical risk is likely to keep energy prices elevated until then.

The diesel market is under particular scrutiny. As Middle‑East tensions rise, diesel has become one of the biggest concerns in the global oil market because the region supplies not only large volumes of diesel but also the specific crude grades needed to produce it. Ukraine’s attacks on Russian refineries have also squeezed global diesel supply, pushing prices to record highs.

European gas‑oil futures hit historic peaks on Tuesday, and US ultra‑low‑sulfur diesel futures also reached record levels the same day. Naga.com analyst Frank Walbaum noted that Europe has lost a substantial amount of diesel and jet‑fuel supply from the Middle East, while the Eastern‑European situation is further disrupting output at several major Russian refineries and prompting Moscow to curb fuel exports.

The Russian government has decided to extend diesel export restrictions for fuel producers until the end of October, Vedomosti reported on Tuesday evening citing two unnamed sources that the limits will remain in place. Staunovo said that unless a peace deal is reached in the Middle East or the Russian situation improves, diesel prices are likely to stay supported.

Overall, Saudi Arabia’s increased oil shipments via Oman, combined with a smaller‑than‑expected drop in US crude inventories, has pulled oil prices down from recent highs. Yet the Yanbu export disruption, low traffic through the Strait of Hormuz, escalating Saudi‑Houthi clashes, and tight global diesel supplies keep the energy market highly uncertain, and future price moves will depend on the speed of Middle‑East supply recovery and geopolitical developments.

items.title: Fed升息1碼惹怒川普 喊話利率應降至1%以下
items.title_en: Fed Rate Hike Angers Trump, Calls for Rates Below 1%
paras: 聯準會 (Fed) 週三 (16 日) 宣布2023年以來首次升息後，美國總統川普隨即要求央行迅速將利率降至1%或更低。白宮亦批評這項決定「相當令人遺憾」，認為升息缺乏充分的經濟依據，但未直接批評Fed主席華許。
Fed稍早以12比0一致決議升息1碼，將聯邦資金利率目標區間調高至3.75%至4%。聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 在聲明中表示，通膨仍處於高檔；最新利率預測顯示，多數官員認為今年可能再次升息。
川普隨後在Truth Social發文表示，美國利率「應該降至1%或更低」，理由是美國擁有全球最佳信用。他並以全大寫文字要求：「為美國降低利率，而且要快！」
川普聲稱，美國正在支撐全球多數國家，這種情況不能繼續下去。他並以美國吸引大量新增投資，以及對許多國家存在貿易逆差為由，主張美國應適用更低利率。
白宮發言人德賽 (Kush Desai) 接受福斯新聞訪問時表示，川普已清楚說明希望利率朝哪個方向移動，而Fed當天決定升息，從政府立場來看「相當令人遺憾」，也缺乏特別有力的經濟依據。
德賽指出，目前並非拜登政府時期，川普與共和黨沒有投入數兆美元的新冠疫情刺激支出，因此不存在需要透過提高利率加以抑制的失控總需求。
儘管白宮反對這次升息，德賽仍表示，川普相信Fed應保持獨立，但這不影響總統在認為政策出現問題時公開表達意見的權利。
川普近期已重新加大對Fed的施壓力道。不到兩週前，他曾警告，如果Fed不降息，可能停止與對美國享有貿易順差的國家進行貿易，涉及美國多數主要貿易夥伴及其他數十個國家。
不過，川普與白宮官員目前仍未直接抨擊由川普任命的華許。華許接替鮑爾出任Fed主席後，川普對央行的公開施壓一度減弱，如今情況可能隨著Fed轉向升息而改變，華許也將面臨更大的白宮政治壓力。
paras_en: The Federal Reserve announced on Wednesday the 16th that it had raised rates for the first time since 2023, prompting President Trump to immediately demand that the central bank swiftly cut rates to 1% or lower. The White House also criticized the decision as "quite regrettable," saying the hike lacked sufficient economic justification, though it did not directly criticize Fed Chair Jerome Powell.

Earlier that day, the Fed voted unanimously 12‑0 to raise rates by one quarter point, moving the federal funds target range to 3.75%‑4%. In its statement, the Federal Open Market Committee said inflation remains high; the latest rate forecasts show most officials think another hike could be possible this year.

Trump then posted on Truth Social that U.S. rates "should be cut to 1% or lower," arguing that the United States has the best credit in the world. He wrote in all‑caps: "Lower rates for America, and do it fast!"

Trump claimed the United States is supporting most of the world’s economies and that this situation cannot continue. Citing the influx of new investment into the U.S. and large trade deficits with many countries, he argued that America should enjoy lower rates.

White House spokesperson Kush Desai told Fox News that Trump has made clear the direction he wants rates to move, and that the Fed’s decision to raise rates that day was "quite regrettable" from the government’s perspective and lacked particularly strong economic justification.

Desai noted that this is not the Biden administration era; Trump and the Republican Party have not poured trillions of dollars into COVID‑19 stimulus, so there is no runaway aggregate demand that needs to be curbed by higher rates.

Although the White House opposes the hike, Desai said Trump believes the Fed should remain independent, and that does not prevent the president from publicly voicing his opinion when he thinks policy is wrong.

Trump has recently stepped up pressure on the Fed again. Less than two weeks ago he warned that if the Fed does not cut rates, he could halt trade with countries that run trade surpluses with the United States, affecting most of America’s major trading partners and dozens of other nations.

However, neither Trump nor White House officials have directly attacked Powell, who was appointed by Trump. After Powell succeeded Jerome Powell as Fed chair, Trump’s public pressure on the central bank had eased, but the situation may change as the Fed moves toward hikes, and Powell could face greater political pressure from the White House.

items.title: 英特爾上漲4% 投資人盼記憶體晶片成轉型下一步
items.title_en: Intel Rises 4% as Investors Hope Memory Chips Are the Next Step in Its Transformation
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，英特爾(Intel)(INTC-US)的起源可追溯到記憶體晶片業務，但由於經濟效益不佳，公司後來退出了這項業務。不過，隨著記憶體晶片市場再次熱絡，投資人期待英特爾能重新參與其中。
英特爾股價周三上漲4%。
據《路透社》昨夜消息，英特爾正在與SK海力士(SK Hynix)(SKHY-US)進行討論。這家南韓晶片製造商正考慮於美國生產記憶體晶片。
報導指出，SK海力士的選項包括租用英特爾位於俄亥俄州一座規劃中的廠房部分設施，或與英特爾及其他公司成立合資企業。
消息指出，目前雙方的討論仍處於「探索階段」，最終不一定會形成商業合作關係。此外，南韓政府可能反對這類合作。
英特爾發言人表示，「作為公司政策，我們不會針對媒體對未來商業安排的猜測發表評論。不過，英特爾致力於俄亥俄州，我們也持續投資，以加快該基地的建設準備工作。」
英特爾目前並不銷售記憶體晶片，但公司確實提供晶片製造產能。大多數美國晶片公司都將半導體製造外包給台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)。但英特爾同時具備自行製造晶片的能力，也有能力為其晶圓代工部門爭取具規模的業務，該部門負責替其他業界公司製造晶片。
英特爾正處於一場復興之中，公司已獲得美國政府與輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)的投資，同時人工智慧也正重新點燃其業務成長。
隨著新型AI工作負載需要更多CPU，英特爾用於伺服器的CPU已成為市場熱門商品。
這代表AI產業的敘事出現轉變。早期的AI發展敘事中，相較於輝達生產的GPU等產品，CPU的重要性較低。
記憶體晶片則是AI硬體市場中另一個熱門領域。目前只有少數幾家公司能夠生產記憶體晶片，且其生產速度仍不足以滿足從事資料密集型工作負載的AI公司強勁需求。
即使企業決定擴大產能，也需要時間才能真正增加製造能力。而目前主要業者確實都有提升產能的計畫，但同時對擴產保持審慎態度。
paras_en: MarketWatch reports that Intel’s origins trace back to the memory‑chip business, but poor economics led the company to exit that segment. Now, with the memory market heating up again, investors are hoping Intel will re‑enter it.
Intel’s stock jumped 4% on Wednesday.
According to Reuters last night, Intel is in talks with SK Hynix. The South Korean chipmaker is considering producing memory chips in the United States.
The report says SK Hynix’s options include leasing part of Intel’s planned Ohio fab or forming a joint venture with Intel and other partners.
Sources say the discussions are still in an “exploratory” phase and may not result in a commercial deal, and the South Korean government could oppose such cooperation.

An Intel spokesperson said, “As company policy we do not comment on media speculation about future business arrangements. However, Intel is committed to Ohio and continues to invest to accelerate the site’s build‑out preparation.”

Intel does not currently sell memory chips, but it does offer chip‑manufacturing capacity. Most U.S. chip firms outsource semiconductor production to TSMC, yet Intel both manufactures its own chips and can secure sizable business for its foundry services that produce chips for other companies.
Intel is in the midst of a revival, having secured investment from the U.S. government and Nvidia, while artificial intelligence is reigniting its growth prospects.
As new AI workloads demand more CPUs, Intel’s server CPUs have become hot commodities in the market.
This signals a shift in the AI narrative. In early AI stories, CPUs were seen as less important compared to Nvidia’s GPUs and similar products.

Memory chips are another hot segment of the AI hardware market. Only a handful of firms can produce them, and current production speeds fall short of the strong demand from data‑intensive AI workloads.

Even when companies decide to expand capacity, it takes time to truly increase manufacturing output. While the major players do have plans to boost capacity, they remain cautious about rapid expansion.

items.title: 不再一條龍！三星客製化HBM擬採雙軌並行：自廠或台積電製造基礎裸片任客戶挑
items.title_en: No More One‑Stop Shop! Samsung’s Custom HBM to Use Dual‑Track Parallel Strategy: Customers Can Choose In‑House or TSMC‑Made Base Dies
paras: 最新消息傳出，三星在客製化HBM將採雙軌策略，依客戶需求提供自廠或台積電基礎裸片(Base Die)，若選台積電，由記憶體業務負責設計，已有客戶採「台積電Base Bie＋三星DRAM」方案，顯示其不再堅持一體化供貨，改以提高供應鏈彈性接單。
高頻寬記憶體(HBM)架構正出現關鍵轉折，過往基礎裸片(Base Die)多用DRAM製程，自HBM4起逐步改由邏輯代工生產，以解決AI高速運算下的散熱、訊號延遲與能效問題，客製化HBM更可把記憶體控制器等功能下移到底層，使得「記憶體堆疊」更接近運算系統。
三星HBM4以自家代工生產基礎裸片，SK海力士、美光則與台積電合作，業界估邏輯base die成本高於傳統DRAM方案，三星因自有代工在內部生產與產能調配具潛在彈性，通用HBM4量產已佔先機。
另有傳聞指出，SK海力士自HBM4E起評估把部分基礎裸片交英特爾代工，降低對台積電單一依賴、兼顧成本與供應穩定，但SK海力士對相關技術細節僅回應「難以確認」、部分報導不實。
分析人士指出，隨著AI加速器客制化程度升高，base die已成HBM新戰場，擁代工、擁多供應商與能整合控制器者，將在主權、雲端客戶爭單中更具談判空間。
paras_en: The latest news reports that Samsung will adopt a dual‑track strategy for custom HBM, offering customers either in‑house or TSMC‑fabricated base dies (Base Die) according to their needs. If TSMC is chosen, the memory business unit handles the design, and some customers have already taken the “TSMC Base Die + Samsung DRAM” approach, showing that Samsung is no longer insisting on a fully integrated supply and is instead increasing supply‑chain flexibility to win orders.

High‑bandwidth memory (HBM) architecture is reaching a critical turning point. Historically, base dies were mostly produced with DRAM processes, but starting with HBM4 they are gradually being made by logic foundries to address heat, signal‑delay and energy‑efficiency challenges of AI‑heavy workloads. Custom HBM can also push functions such as the memory controller down to the lower layers, making the “memory stack” sit even closer to the compute system.

Samsung’s HBM4 uses its own fabs to produce the base die, while SK Hynix and Micron partner with TSMC. Industry estimates that logic‑based base dies cost more than traditional DRAM solutions, but Samsung’s internal manufacturing gives it potential flexibility in production and capacity allocation, giving it an early lead in mass‑producing generic HBM4.

There are also rumors that SK Hynix, starting with HBM4E, is evaluating handing over part of its base‑die production to Intel’s foundry to reduce reliance on a single TSMC supplier and balance cost and supply stability. SK Hynix, however, only said the details are “hard to confirm,” and some reports are inaccurate.

Analysts note that as AI accelerators become more customized, the base die has become the new battleground for HBM. Companies that own a fab, have multiple suppliers and can integrate the controller will have greater negotiating power when competing for sovereign and cloud customers.

items.title: Fed 3年來首度升息後 市場押注再升息 加元重貶至6週低點
items.title_en: After the Fed's First Rate Hike in Three Years, Markets Bet on Further Hikes as the Canadian Dollar Slumps to a Six‑Week Low
paras: 加拿大元周三(16日)走弱，兌美元跌至6週低點，主要受到美國聯準會(Fed)宣布3年來首度升息，以及市場進一步押注未來數月仍可能持續升息的影響。加元盤中一度觸及1美元兌1.3994加元，為8月7日以來最低，尾盤報1.3990加元，單日下跌0.5%，相當於1加元兌71.48美分。
聯準會周三將基準利率上調25個基點至3.75%-4.00%，並釋放未來數月可能進一步提高借貸成本的訊號，目標是讓通膨更及時回到2%的政策目標。聯準會最新聲明指出，美國經濟活動仍以穩健速度擴張，生產力成長強勁、資本投資保持韌性，但通膨仍處於偏高水準，因此本次升息有助於加快通膨回落至2%。
市場對後續升息的預期同步升溫，美元因此走強，進一步壓抑加元表現。Corpay(CPAY-US)首席市場策略師Karl Schamotta表示，美元兌主要貨幣持續走高，美國公債殖利率也在對貨幣政策敏感的期限段上升，投資人正逐步提高對聯準會12月再次升息的預期。
聯準會最新經濟預測也顯示，18名政策制定者中有16人預期今年底前至少還會升息1次，若按照多數官員預測，聯邦基金利率年底可能升至4.00%-4.25%區間，顯示聯準會在通膨仍偏高的情況下，並未排除持續緊縮的可能性。
加拿大方面，市場同樣開始評估加拿大央行後續升息可能性。互換市場數據顯示，加拿大央行未來幾個月也可能收緊貨幣政策。加拿大央行9月2日維持隔夜利率目標在2.25%，當時已指出通膨上行風險升高，尤其高油價持續時間越長，能源成本向其他商品與服務價格擴散的風險越大。
加拿大央行9月會議紀要顯示，決策官員認為通膨短期內可能維持在較高水準。央行9月2日公布的政策聲明則指出，加拿大第2季GDP年化成長率達3.3%，經濟活動普遍改善，消費、住宅市場、出口及企業投資均有所回升；7月失業率則降至6.4%。不過，央行同時表示，美國新關稅及加拿大反制措施仍使經濟前景存在高度不確定性。
能源價格走勢也對加元構成壓力。原油是加拿大主要出口商品之一，國際油價周三下跌，市場因沙烏地阿拉伯透過阿曼提供額外原油貨載的消息，降低對中東供應中斷規模的疑慮。美國原油期貨周三結算下跌3.2%，報每桶102.43美元。
油價下跌對加元尤其受到關注，因能源出口是加拿大經濟與貿易的重要組成部分。當原油價格回落時，加拿大出口收入及商品貨幣相關資金流可能受到影響，加上美元受到美國升息預期支撐，雙重因素使加元承受壓力。
加拿大國內經濟數據亦未提供加元太多支撐。加拿大8月房屋開工率折合年率為229,046戶，低於7月經修正後的229,360戶，也低於經濟學家預期的240,000戶，顯示住宅建設活動略有降溫。
加拿大公債殖利率則呈現曲線趨平走勢。2年期殖利率上升2個基點至3.376%，10年期殖利率則下滑1.1個基點至3.941%，延續周一觸及接近3年高點3.987%後的回落走勢。
在美加利差重新受到市場關注之際，美元走強也不只壓抑加元。聯準會升息後，美元指數周三上漲0.3%，報99.961，創近5週新高；歐元下跌0.3%至1.1502美元，英鎊下跌0.5%至1.34155美元，美元兌日元則上升0.3%至155.49日元。
加拿大央行目前的政策利率仍明顯低於聯準會，但若美國持續升息、加拿大央行維持利率不變，美加利率差可能進一步擴大，成為支撐美元兌加元匯率的重要因素。不過，加拿大央行9月政策聲明也指出，將持續評估經濟復甦的可持續性及通膨前景，並準備在必要時調整貨幣政策。
因此，近期加元走勢將同時受到聯準會後續利率路徑、加拿大央行政策方向、美元表現及原油價格影響。市場目前尤其關注聯準會是否在今年底前再度升息，以及加拿大通膨與經濟數據是否足以促使加拿大央行改變目前的政策立場。
paras_en: The Canadian dollar weakened on Wednesday, falling to a six‑week low against the U.S. dollar, mainly due to the Federal Reserve’s announcement of its first rate hike in three years and markets further betting that rate increases could continue in the coming months. The CAD briefly touched 1.3994 per U.S. dollar, the lowest since August 7, and closed at 1.3990, down 0.5% for the day, equivalent to 1 CAD = 71.48 US cents.

The Fed raised its benchmark rate by 25 basis points on Wednesday to a target range of 3.75%‑4.00% and signaled that borrowing costs could rise further in the months ahead, aiming to bring inflation back to the 2% policy goal more promptly. The Fed’s latest statement noted that U.S. economic activity is still expanding at a solid pace, productivity growth is strong, capital investment remains resilient, but inflation remains elevated, so this hike helps accelerate inflation’s return to 2%.

Market expectations for additional hikes warmed up in tandem, strengthening the dollar and further suppressing the Canadian dollar. Corpay (CPAY‑US) chief market strategist Karl Schamotta said the dollar’s rise against major currencies continues, U.S. Treasury yields are also climbing in policy‑sensitive maturities, and investors are gradually raising expectations for another Fed hike in December.

The Fed’s latest economic forecasts also show that 16 of 18 policymakers expect at least one more hike before the end of the year; based on the majority view, the federal funds rate could end the year in the 4.00%‑4.25% range, indicating the Fed has not ruled out continued tightening while inflation stays above target.

In Canada, the market likewise began assessing the possibility of further Bank of Canada hikes. Swap‑market data suggest the BoC may tighten policy over the next few months. The BoC kept its overnight rate target at 2.25% on September 2, noting heightened upside inflation risks, especially the longer high oil prices persist, the greater the risk that energy costs will spill over into other goods and services.

BoC September meeting minutes showed policymakers believe inflation could remain at a relatively high level in the short term. The policy statement released on September 2 said Canada’s Q2 GDP grew at an annualized 3.3%, economic activity broadly improved, and consumption, housing, exports and business investment all rebounded; July unemployment fell to 6.4%. However, the bank also said new U.S. tariffs and Canadian counter‑measures keep the economic outlook highly uncertain.

Energy‑price trends also put pressure on the CAD. Crude oil is one of Canada’s main export commodities, and international oil prices fell on Wednesday as the market eased concerns over Middle‑East supply disruptions after Saudi Arabia offered additional cargoes via Oman. U.S. crude futures settled down 3.2% at $102.43 a barrel.

The oil‑price drop is especially watched for the CAD because energy exports are a key component of Canada’s economy and trade. When oil prices retreat, Canadian export revenues and commodity‑currency flows may be affected, and with the dollar supported by U.S. rate‑hike expectations, the dual factors pressure the CAD.

Domestic Canadian economic data also gave little support to the CAD. August housing starts were 229,046 units annualized, below July’s revised 229,360 and below economists’ forecast of 240,000, indicating a slight cooling in residential construction activity.

Canadian government‑bond yields showed a flattening curve. The two‑year yield rose 2 basis points to 3.376%, while the ten‑year slipped 1.1 basis points to 3.941%, continuing the pull‑back after hitting near a three‑year high of 3.987% on Monday.

As the Canada‑U.S. rate differential again draws market attention, a stronger dollar also suppresses the CAD. After the Fed hike, the dollar index rose 0.3% on Wednesday to 99.961, a near‑five‑week high; the euro fell 0.3% to $1.1502, the pound slipped 0.5% to $1.34155, and the dollar rose 0.3% against the yen to ¥155.49.

The BoC’s policy rate remains clearly below the Fed’s, but if the U.S. continues hiking while the BoC holds rates steady, the Canada‑U.S. rate gap could widen further, becoming a key driver of the USD/CAD exchange rate. However, the BoC’s September policy statement also said it will keep assessing the sustainability of the economic recovery and the inflation outlook, and is ready to adjust policy if needed.

Therefore, the CAD’s near‑term trajectory will be shaped by the Fed’s future rate path, BoC policy direction, dollar performance and oil prices. Markets are especially focused on whether the Fed will hike again before year‑end and whether Canadian inflation and economic data are strong enough to prompt the BoC to change its current stance.

items.title: 速度快200倍、成本降400倍！前OpenAI研究員閉關兩年 推出LLM新模型Jev
items.title_en: 200× Faster, 400× Cheaper! Former OpenAI Researcher Returns After Two Years with New LLM Model Jev
paras: 發明ChatGPT的核心科學家閉關兩年後，反手給整個大模型行業敲了一錘喪鐘。前OpenAI核心研究員，ChatGPT、GPT-4論文重要貢獻者，現TypeSafe創始人Diogo Almeida公布了一種全新模型：Jev，在開發者圈迅速走紅。
Jev這個名字取自傑文斯悖論（Jevons paradox），同時寓意它在「每美元所能換取的智慧」指標上表現爆表。
與現有的LLM模型相比，Jev在系統任務上達到了類似的智慧水平，但速度和效率提高了兩個數量級，雖然Jev不具備字符串生成功能，但它針對結構化輸出進行了優化，並且不會產生幻覺。
Diogo Almeida稱團隊歷時兩年「秘密」研發，構建了一個完全專注於自動化的新堆棧：採用新的模型架構、並行採樣器以實現最高效率，以及一種新的模型訓練方法（RLCD）。
簡單來說就是，開發者可以把Jev看作是一個前沿智慧函數調用：輸入非結構化狀態，輸出類型化的概率決策。
在所有人的慣性思維裡，大模型必須會出口成章、會長篇大論，但Jev走向了完全相反的方向——它徹底閹割了自然語言生成能力，絕不吐半句廢話，只在毫秒級內給出最精準的概率分布與結構化判定。
Diogo Almeida介紹，相比現有的LLM模型，Jev速度快20-200倍，成本低40-400倍（輸出令牌免費），聽起來好得令人難以置信。
成本方面，LLM模型輸入token約0.20-10美元/百萬token，輸出開銷約為輸入token的5倍，而Jev輸入token為0.042美元/百萬token（即每十億token42美元），輸出token不計費（成本極低，無需計量）。
訓練優化方式方面，LLM模型普遍基於人類反饋的強化學習（RLHF）/可驗證獎勵強化學習（RLVR）；Jev的訓練方法為校準決策強化學習（RLCD）。
速度方面，先進模型端到端響應時間：3-329秒，對人機互動尚可，但嵌入程式碼時會成為巨大性能瓶頸；Jev模型的端到端響應為70-500毫秒，針對系統一類任務，同等智慧水平下，速度提升40-200倍。
Jev模型可用於四類場景：
1、AI驅動業務流程／智慧條件判斷。結構化輸出直接接入普通軟體，充當模糊決策規則：分類、路由、打分、資訊提取、分支判斷；替代難以維護的手寫邏輯；程式碼約束模型輸出邊界，更容易構建穩定可靠系統。
2、大數據Map-Reduce處理：PB級數據提取特徵、挖掘洞察。
3、實時應用：100ms級別延遲，可用於對互動體驗要求嚴苛的產品。
4、全鏈路校驗：打分、評判、核驗、安全防護，以及檢測大模型提示詞越獄、推理鏈路、模型輸出的安全風險。
這種性能說出來可能沒人信，該團隊在技術報告中表示歡迎質疑者自行驗證。
官方對照Demo直觀展現了Jev模型與傳統LLM模型的核心差異：Jev會並行輸出全部概率結果，而不是按token自回歸逐個生成，幾乎秒出結果；普通LLM字符串文本生成雖然能力極強、通用性高，但代價高昂。
在這個示例中，該團隊選用的對照模型是默認配置的GPT-5.6 Terra，原因是它的平均智慧水平與目前的Jev最為接近。
此外，該團隊還設計了一套新的評測方式，用來衡量AI在程式碼內部的實際運行效果。
具體而言，預先設定一套正確的計算圖（以程式碼實現的「工作流」），並把業界規模最大、能力最強、成本最高的外部大模型給出的預測結果，作為參考概率基準。
所有模型運行完全相同的工作流，測試各個模型與頂尖模型集合的平均輸出之間的差距，選用的基準模型為當下的旗艦模型GPT-6 Astra與Claude Fable 5.1。
Jev的表現遠超預期，佔據帕累托最優前沿，性能差距接近兩個數量級，而依靠生成提示詞、把全部邏輯放在思維鏈（CoT）內部完成推理的模型，表現明顯劣於直接使用工作流本身。
另一大突出優勢在於幻覺與類型安全方面。代理場景下，發生幻覺導致工具調用出錯頂多帶來使用不便，但如果這套系統有延遲保障要求，或是調用鏈路深埋在多層依賴鏈之中，幻覺問題就會直接讓整套系統徹底不可用。
現有的大模型，最讓人抓馬的死穴是它有時候會在不知道答案時依然選擇自信地「胡說八道」，無論如今能力有多強，依然會有概率產生幻覺，同時還會出現類型錯誤。
而Jev模型輸出的每一個數值和選項，都帶著嚴格校準後的真實勝率與置信度，它很清楚自己知不知道，在數學層面上把幻覺徹底焊死降為0。
paras_en: After two years of seclusion, the core scientist who invented ChatGPT has dealt a death blow to the entire large‑model industry. Former OpenAI core researcher and key contributor to the ChatGPT and GPT‑4 papers, now founder of TypeSafe Diogo Almeida, announced a brand‑new model called Jev, which quickly went viral in developer circles.
The name Jev comes from Jevons paradox and also implies that it blows past the metric of “intelligence per dollar”.

Compared with existing LLMs, Jev reaches a comparable level of intelligence on system‑level tasks but is two orders of magnitude faster and more efficient. Although Jev lacks free‑form string generation, it is optimized for structured output and does not hallucinate.

Diogo Almeida said the team spent two years in “secret” development to build a stack focused entirely on automation: a new model architecture, a parallel sampler for maximum efficiency, and a novel training method called RLCD.
In simple terms, developers can think of Jev as a cutting‑edge intelligent function call: it takes unstructured input and returns typed probabilistic decisions.

Conventional wisdom holds that large models must produce fluent prose and long passages, but Jev goes in the opposite direction—it completely disables natural‑language generation, never spews filler, and delivers the most precise probability distribution and structured judgment within milliseconds.
Almeida claims Jev is 20‑200× faster than current LLMs and 40‑400× cheaper (output tokens are free), sounding almost too good to be true.

In cost terms, typical LLMs charge about $0.20‑$10 per million input tokens and output costs are roughly five times the input cost. Jev charges $0.042 per million input tokens (about $42 per billion tokens) and does not bill for output tokens, making its cost negligible.
Regarding training, most LLMs rely on reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) or verifiable reward RL (RLVR). Jev is trained with calibrated‑decision reinforcement learning (RLCD).

Speed-wise, state‑of‑the‑art models have end‑to‑end latencies of 3‑329 seconds, which is acceptable for human‑machine interaction but becomes a bottleneck when embedded in code. Jev’s end‑to‑end latency is 70‑500 ms, giving a 40‑200× speed boost for system‑type tasks at comparable intelligence.
Jev can be applied in four categories of scenarios:

1. AI‑driven business processes and intelligent conditional judgments. Structured outputs plug directly into ordinary software, acting as fuzzy decision rules for classification, routing, scoring, information extraction, branch decisions; they replace hard‑to‑maintain hand‑written logic; code‑constrained model outputs are easier to build into stable, reliable systems.
2. Big‑data Map‑Reduce processing: extracting features and insights from petabyte‑scale datasets.
3. Real‑time applications: 100 ms‑level latency suitable for products with strict interaction‑experience requirements.
4. End‑to‑end verification: scoring, judging, validating, security protection, and detecting prompt jailbreaks, reasoning chain issues, and safety risks in model outputs.
The performance sounds unbelievable, but the team states in its technical report that skeptics are welcome to verify it themselves.

The official demo visually contrasts Jev with traditional LLMs: Jev outputs all probability results in parallel instead of generating tokens autoregressively one by one, delivering results almost instantly; conventional LLMs excel at free‑form text generation but at a high cost.
In the demo, the baseline model is the default‑configuration GPT‑5.6 Terra, chosen because its average intelligence level is closest to the current Jev.
The team also devised a new evaluation method to measure AI’s actual runtime effect inside code.

Specifically, they pre‑define a correct computation graph (a “workflow” implemented in code) and use the predictions of the industry’s largest, most capable, and most expensive external LLM as a reference probability baseline.
All models run the identical workflow, and the gap between each model’s average output and the top‑model ensemble is measured; the benchmark models are the flagship GPT‑6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1.

Jev’s performance far exceeds expectations, occupying the Pareto‑optimal frontier with a performance gap of nearly two orders of magnitude. Models that rely on prompt generation and keep all reasoning inside a chain‑of‑thought (CoT) perform noticeably worse than using the workflow directly.

Another major advantage is in hallucination and type safety. In agent scenarios, hallucinations that cause tool‑call errors may be merely inconvenient, but if the system requires latency guarantees or the call chain is buried deep in multiple dependencies, hallucinations can render the entire system unusable.

Existing large models’ biggest flaw is that they sometimes confidently “make stuff up” when they don’t know the answer; no matter how capable they become, they still have a non‑zero probability of hallucinating and can produce type errors.
Every value and option output by Jev carries a rigorously calibrated real‑world win rate and confidence level; it knows whether it knows, and mathematically eliminates hallucinations to zero.

items.title: 不再一條龍！三星客製化HBM擬採雙軌並行：自廠或台積電製造基礎裸片任客戶挑
items.title_en: No More One‑Stop Shop! Samsung’s Custom HBM to Use Dual‑Track Parallel Strategy: Customers Can Choose In‑House or TSMC‑Made Base Dies
paras: 最新消息傳出，三星在客製化HBM將採雙軌策略，依客戶需求提供自廠或台積電基礎裸片(Base Die)，若選台積電，由記憶體業務負責設計，已有客戶採「台積電Base Bie＋三星DRAM」方案，顯示其不再堅持一體化供貨，改以提高供應鏈彈性接單。
高頻寬記憶體(HBM)架構正出現關鍵轉折，過往基礎裸片(Base Die)多用DRAM製程，自HBM4起逐步改由邏輯代工生產，以解決AI高速運算下的散熱、訊號延遲與能效問題，客製化HBM更可把記憶體控制器等功能下移到底層，使得「記憶體堆疊」更接近運算系統。
三星HBM4以自家代工生產基礎裸片，SK海力士、美光則與台積電合作，業界估邏輯base die成本高於傳統DRAM方案，三星因自有代工在內部生產與產能調配具潛在彈性，通用HBM4量產已佔先機。
另有傳聞指出，SK海力士自HBM4E起評估把部分基礎裸片交英特爾代工，降低對台積電單一依賴、兼顧成本與供應穩定，但SK海力士對相關技術細節僅回應「難以確認」、部分報導不實。
分析人士指出，隨著AI加速器客制化程度升高，base die已成HBM新戰場，擁代工、擁多供應商與能整合控制器者，將在主權、雲端客戶爭單中更具談判空間。
paras_en: The latest news reports that Samsung will adopt a dual‑track strategy for custom HBM, offering customers either in‑house or TSMC‑fabricated base dies (Base Die) according to their needs. If TSMC is chosen, the memory business unit handles the design, and some customers have already taken the “TSMC Base Die + Samsung DRAM” approach, showing that Samsung is no longer insisting on a fully integrated supply and is instead increasing supply‑chain flexibility to win orders.

High‑bandwidth memory (HBM) architecture is reaching a critical turning point. Historically, base dies were mostly produced with DRAM processes, but starting with HBM4 they are gradually being made by logic foundries to address heat, signal‑delay and energy‑efficiency challenges of AI‑heavy workloads. Custom HBM can also push functions such as the memory controller down to the lower layers, making the “memory stack” sit even closer to the compute system.

Samsung’s HBM4 uses its own fabs to produce the base die, while SK Hynix and Micron partner with TSMC. Industry estimates that logic‑based base dies cost more than traditional DRAM solutions, but Samsung’s internal manufacturing gives it potential flexibility in production and capacity allocation, giving it an early lead in mass‑producing generic HBM4.

There are also rumors that SK Hynix, starting with HBM4E, is evaluating handing over part of its base‑die production to Intel’s foundry to reduce reliance on a single TSMC supplier and balance cost and supply stability. SK Hynix, however, only said the details are “hard to confirm,” and some reports are inaccurate.

Analysts note that as AI accelerators become more customized, the base die has become the new battleground for HBM. Companies that own a fab, have multiple suppliers and can integrate the controller will have greater negotiating power when competing for sovereign and cloud customers.

paras: 台股盤前要聞

2.台股16日45848.9點，上漲337.41點，成交量6437.65億元，其中外資賣超179.8億元，已連五賣，主要賣超00981A主動統一台股增長 2.4萬張，009816凱基台灣TOP50 1.9萬張，元大台灣50 1.6萬張。
3.新台幣兌美元16日震盪，市場對美國聯準會(Fed)升息預期升溫，加上國際油價續揚推升通膨疑慮、美債殖利率突破5%，主要亞幣持續承壓，新台幣早盤一度貶破31.9元關卡，面臨 32 元保衛戰，隨後雖受台股反彈帶動強勢翻紅，但終場仍敵不過美元買盤，收在31.888元，貶值4分，呈現連 5 貶，探近 1 個月新低，台北外匯市場成交金額縮至 13.94 億美元，市場轉趨觀望。
4.華邦電(2344-TW)16日召開訊記者會宣布海外併購案，與英飛凌旗下Infineon Technologies LLC簽署股份購買協議，以全現金方式取得英飛凌旗下NOR Flash及相關記憶體事業標的公司100%股權，基礎交易價格達11.2億美元，折合新台幣約356.23億元，預計2027年下半年完成交易，收購完畢後，標的公司將以「Spansion」為名，延續該品牌價值。
5.瑞銀台灣證券策略師暨非科技產業分析師陳玟瑾針對總體經濟環境、美聯準會利率動向、台股資金流動性及非科技產業投資策略發表最新展望。看好台股獲利上修，指出雖然美聯準會（Fed）年底前仍有升息可能，但台股企業獲利大幅上修的力道遠大於利率對估值的折現效應，整體台股大盤與資金動能依然極具支撐力。目前台股整體融資維持率維持在170%至180%的健康水準，預估新台幣今年均價約在32元、明年看31元，
6.瑞銀指出，AI需求至2027年持續強勁，產業成長重心逐漸由GPU訓練延伸至推理運算、ASIC及機櫃級解決方案，帶動液冷與電力分配需求。目前產業發展瓶頸仍為電力輸送能力與記憶體等關鍵零組件供應，而非終端需求，供需吃緊狀況預期延續至2027年，規模較大的供應商有望受惠於採購優勢，進一步提升市佔率。
7.鴻海(2317-TW)旗下鴻騰精密(FIT)(6088-HK)董事長盧松青16日表示，目前光通訊最大的瓶頸仍是材料供給，包括Fiber、Laser、Chip、CW Laser及晶圓等都缺，材料已成為限制光通訊產業成長速度的關鍵因素。

paras_en: Taiwan Stock Market Pre‑Market News

The Federal Reserve announced on Wednesday (the 16th) a 25‑basis‑point rate hike, with all 12 members of the Federal Open Market Committee voting to raise the target range for the federal funds rate to 3.75%‑4%, marking the first hike since July 2023. In U.S. markets, the Dow rose 0.63% while the other three major indices closed lower. Taiwan futures kept climbing in the night session, ending up more than 250 points near 46,325, and TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) finished up 1.31%.

Taiwan’s main index closed at 45,848.9 points on the 16th, up 337.41 points with a turnover of NT$643.765 billion. Foreign investors sold a net NT$17.9 billion for the fifth consecutive day, mainly shorting 00981A (Unified Taiwan Stock Growth) with 24,000 lots, 009816 (KGI Taiwan TOP50) with 19,000 lots, and Yuanta Taiwan 50 with 16,000 lots.

The New Taiwan dollar fluctuated against the US dollar on the 16th as expectations for further Fed hikes rose, global oil prices kept climbing fueling inflation concerns, and US Treasury yields broke 5%. Major Asian currencies remained under pressure; the NTD briefly fell below the NT$31.9 per dollar mark, prompting a “defend the 32‑yuan line” battle. Although a rebound in the Taiwan market gave the NTD a temporary rally, it closed at NT$31.888, down 0.04 yuan – the fifth consecutive depreciation and near a one‑month low. Turnover in Taipei’s foreign‑exchange market shrank to US$1.394 billion as participants turned more cautious.

Winbond (2344‑TW) held a press conference on the 16th to announce an overseas acquisition. It signed a share‑purchase agreement with Infineon Technologies LLC, a subsidiary of Infineon, to acquire 100% of the NOR Flash and related memory business for cash. The deal is valued at US$1.12 billion (about NT$35.623 billion) and is expected to close in the second half of 2027. After the acquisition, the target company will operate under the “Spansion” name, preserving the brand’s value.

UBS Taiwan securities strategist and non‑technology analyst Chen Wen‑jin presented his latest outlook on the macro environment, Fed rate moves, Taiwan market liquidity and non‑tech investment strategies. He is optimistic about earnings upgrades in Taiwanese equities, noting that while the Fed may still raise rates before year‑end, the upside from corporate profit revisions outweighs the discount effect of higher rates on valuations. Overall market breadth and capital flows remain strong. The overall financing margin in Taiwan stays at a healthy 170%‑180%, and the average NTD exchange rate is projected around NT$32 this year and NT$31 next year.

UBS highlighted that AI demand will stay robust through 2027, with industry growth shifting from GPU training to inference, ASICs and rack‑scale solutions, driving demand for liquid cooling and power distribution. The sector’s bottlenecks remain power delivery capacity and key components such as memory, rather than end‑user demand. Tight supply‑demand conditions are expected to persist to 2027, and larger suppliers could benefit from procurement advantages to increase market share.

Foxconn (2317‑TW) subsidiary FIT (FIT, 6088‑HK) chairman Lu Songqing said on the 16th that the biggest bottleneck in optical communications today is material supply. Shortages of fiber, lasers, chips, continuous‑wave lasers and wafers are limiting the industry’s growth speed.
Foreign investors sold a net NT$17.9 billion for the fifth consecutive day, shorting 00981A and 009816, then reversed to cover positions in the two panel giants.

items.title_en: Winbond Electronics to Spend $1.12 Billion Acquiring Infineon's Memory Business, Targeting AI Servers, Automotive and Low‑Earth‑Orbit Satellites
paras: 2026年09月16日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 華邦電(2344-TW)啟動特殊型記憶體版圖擴張，與英飛凌Infineon Technologies(IFX-DE)簽署最終協議，將以11.2億美元收購英飛凌NOR Flash與F-RAM事業，涵蓋汽車、工業及基礎設施市場相關產品，預計取得監管核准後於2027年下半年完成交易。
這筆交易對華邦電的意義，不只是擴大NOR Flash規模，更在於一次取得英飛凌長期累積的車用、工業與基礎設施產品及客戶基礎，同時新增F-RAM產品線。英飛凌出售後仍將保留SRAM、HyperRAM、nvSRAM及SONOS相關解決方案，並把資本與產品資源進一步集中於核心成長業務。
AI伺服器也是本次收購值得關注的應用之一。英飛凌旗下SEMPER NOR Flash已通過信驊ASPEED(5274-TW)第8代AST2700 BMC平台驗證，可作為BMC韌體儲存裝置，支援系統監控、安全開機、韌體更新與系統復原。隨AI與雲端資料中心持續擴建，BMC及各類控制元件需求增加，NOR Flash作為Code Storage的需求也同步提高。
華邦電本身已切入AI伺服器NOR Flash供應鏈。根據相關供應鏈資料，新一代AI伺服器機櫃NOR Flash用量可達500至600顆，較前一代增加逾2倍，華邦電在相關供應鏈供貨比重約40%至50%。若交易順利完成，英飛凌SEMPER等高可靠度產品與既有客戶基礎，可望進一步補強華邦電在AI伺服器NOR Flash市場的布局。
車用市場則是另一項重要戰略價值。英飛凌NOR Flash長期應用於ADAS、數位座艙、域控制器及其他汽車電子系統，部分產品具備AEC-Q100認證及符合ISO 26262的ASIL-D功能安全設計。華邦電原本已有車規NOR Flash產品，收購後可進一步擴充高階車用記憶體產品與客戶版圖。
F-RAM則是此次交易另一項重要資產。相較NOR Flash主要負責程式碼與韌體儲存，F-RAM具備高耐寫、低功耗，以及斷電後仍能保存資料等特性，寫入耐久度可超過100兆次，適合汽車電子、工業控制、物聯網及醫療設備等需要頻繁寫入與高可靠度的應用。對華邦電而言，取得F-RAM產品線，也代表特殊型記憶體布局從NOR Flash與利基型DRAM，進一步延伸至高耐寫非揮發性記憶體。

航太市場同樣值得關注。英飛凌2025年推出抗輻射NewSpace記憶體產品組合，涵蓋低功耗F-RAM及最高512 Mbit的QSPI NOR Flash，支援攝氏-55°C至+125°C溫度範圍，抗輻射能力最高達100 krad(Si)，鎖定低地球軌道衛星等高可靠度應用。不過，目前交易公告尚未逐項確認NewSpace產品線是否全數包含在此次出售範圍，因此相關航太業務最終移轉內容仍待後續交易文件確認。
華邦電的AI布局也不只NOR Flash。公司目前同步發展利基型DRAM、矽電容（Si-Cap）及CUBE客製化記憶體，其中NOR Flash與矽電容已進入實際出貨階段，CUBE與Enterprise SSD DRAM Cache則瞄準2027年後的成長機會。
其中，矽電容已投入約新台幣40億元建立獨立產線，目前產能已被訂滿，並尋求進一步擴產空間；CUBE則鎖定Edge AI客製化高頻寬記憶體需求。若再納入此次收購的NOR Flash與F-RAM，華邦電產品版圖將從傳統特殊型記憶體，進一步延伸至AI伺服器、汽車電子、先進封裝及高可靠度應用。

paras_en: September 16, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Winbond Electronics (2344‑TW) has launched a special‑type memory expansion, signing a definitive agreement with Infineon Technologies (IFX‑DE) to acquire Infineon's NOR Flash and F‑RAM businesses for $1.12 billion. The deal covers products for automotive, industrial and infrastructure markets and is expected to close in the second half of 2027 after regulatory approval.

The significance of the transaction for Winbond goes beyond enlarging its NOR Flash scale; it also secures Infineon's long‑built automotive, industrial and infrastructure product lines and customer base, while adding an F‑RAM portfolio. Infineon will retain its SRAM, HyperRAM, nvSRAM and SONOS solutions, focusing its capital and product resources on core growth businesses.

AI servers are a key application of the acquisition. Infineon's SEMP­ER NOR Flash has passed validation on ASPEED’s (5274‑TW) 8th‑generation AST2700 BMC platform and can serve as BMC firmware storage, supporting system monitoring, secure boot, firmware updates and system recovery. As AI and cloud data centers continue to expand, demand for BMCs and various control components rises, boosting the need for NOR Flash as code storage.

Winbond is already in the AI‑server NOR Flash supply chain. According to supply‑chain data, the next‑generation AI‑server rack may use 500‑600 NOR Flash chips, more than double the previous generation, with Winbond supplying roughly 40‑50% of that demand. If the deal closes, high‑reliability products such as Infineon’s SEMP­ER and its existing customer base could further strengthen Winbond’s position in the AI‑server NOR Flash market.

The automotive market is another strategic focus. Infineon’s NOR Flash has long been used in ADAS, digital cockpits, domain controllers and other vehicle electronics, with some parts certified to AEC‑Q100 and meeting ISO 26262 ASIL‑D functional‑safety requirements. Winbond already offers automotive‑grade NOR Flash, and the acquisition would expand its high‑end automotive memory products and customer footprint.

F‑RAM is another important asset in the deal. Compared with NOR Flash, which mainly stores code and firmware, F‑RAM offers high write endurance, low power consumption and data retention after power loss, with endurance exceeding 100 trillion writes. It is suited for automotive electronics, industrial control, IoT and medical devices that require frequent writes and high reliability. For Winbond, adding the F‑RAM line extends its special‑type memory portfolio from NOR Flash and niche DRAM to high‑endurance non‑volatile memory.

The aerospace market also merits attention. Infineon launched a radiation‑hard NewSpace memory portfolio in 2025, covering low‑power F‑RAM and up to 512 Mbit QSPI NOR Flash that operate from –55 °C to +125 °C and tolerate up to 100 krad(Si), targeting low‑Earth‑orbit satellites and other high‑reliability applications. However, the transaction announcement has not confirmed whether the entire NewSpace line is included, so the final scope of aerospace assets will be clarified in later transaction documents.

Winbond’s AI strategy is not limited to NOR Flash. The company is simultaneously developing niche DRAM, silicon capacitors (Si‑Cap) and its custom‑memory line CUBE. NOR Flash and Si‑Cap have already entered volume production, while CUBE and Enterprise SSD DRAM Cache are aimed at growth opportunities after 2027.

Approximately NT$4 billion has been invested in an independent Si‑Cap production line, which is now fully booked and seeking further expansion capacity; CUBE targets edge‑AI custom high‑bandwidth memory needs. Adding the acquired NOR Flash and F‑RAM would extend Winbond’s product map from traditional special‑type memory to AI servers, automotive electronics, advanced packaging and high‑reliability applications.

items.title: 華邦電砸356億元收購英飛凌記憶體事業 Spansion品牌復活
items.title_en: WPG Holdings Spends NT$35.6 Billion to Acquire Infineon's Memory Business, Reviving the Spansion Brand
paras: 華邦電(2344-TW)今(16)日召開重訊記者會宣布海外併購案，與英飛凌旗下Infineon Technologies LLC簽署股份購買協議，以全現金方式取得英飛凌旗下NOR Flash及相關記憶體事業標的公司100%股權，基礎交易價格達11.2億美元，折合新台幣約356.23億元，預計2027年下半年完成交易，收購完畢後，標的公司將以「Spansion」為名，延續該品牌價值。
華邦電表示，此次交易完成後，將進一步擴大全球研發資源、供應能力及客戶服務能量，並納入來自10多個國家的專業人才，同時擴大與全球供應鏈合作夥伴的連結，強化華邦電在全球記憶體市場的布局。
華邦電指出，此次收購標的公司總部位於美國加州聖荷西，在記憶體解決方案領域擁有超過30年經驗，並具備完整且差異化的產品組合及既有客戶基礎，交易完成後，標的公司仍將維持既有營運模式獨立運作，並持續以美國作為總部所在地。
值得注意的是，華邦電此次也將重啟「Spansion」品牌。華邦電表示，交易完成後，標的公司將以Spansion為名，重新使用Spansion作為公司名稱及商標。
Spansion過去曾是全球NOR Flash產業的重要業者，並在2014年獲賽普拉斯(Cypress)收購，又跟隨賽普拉斯於2020年被英飛凌以100億歐元收購，在記憶體領域累積多項創新成果與技術突破，現階段產品普遍以Spansion或Cypress字樣存在。
華邦電表示，很高興能再次以Spansion名稱延續相關技術與產業使命，也象徵此次併購除了擴充產品與市場版圖，更將承接既有品牌、技術及客戶資產。
華邦電強調，本次交易基礎價格為11.2億美元，最終交易金額仍將於交割前，依股份購買協議中所訂定的相關條件進行調整。交易預計於2027年下半年完成，但仍須符合包括取得必要主管機關核准等各項交割條件，交易完成後，華邦電將直接或間接持有標的公司100%股權。
paras_en: WPG Holdings (2344‑TW) held a major press conference today (16th) to announce an overseas acquisition, signing a share purchase agreement with Infineon Technologies LLC, a subsidiary of Infineon. The deal will acquire 100% of the NOR Flash and related memory business of Infineon in an all‑cash transaction, with a base price of US$1.12 billion, equivalent to about NT$35.623 billion, and is expected to close in the second half of 2027. After the acquisition, the target will operate under the name “Spansion” to continue the brand’s value.

WPG said that once the transaction is completed, it will further expand its global R&D resources, supply capacity, and customer service capabilities, incorporating professional talent from more than ten countries and deepening connections with global supply‑chain partners, thereby strengthening its positioning in the worldwide memory market.

The target company is headquartered in San Jose, California, and has over 30 years of experience in memory solutions, offering a complete and differentiated product portfolio and an established customer base. After the deal, the company will continue to operate independently under its existing business model, with its headquarters remaining in the United States.
It is noteworthy that WPG will also revive the “Spansion” brand. The company stated that after the transaction, the target will be named Spansion and will reuse the Spansion name and trademark.

Spansion was once a major player in the global NOR Flash industry. It was acquired by Cypress in 2014, and then Cypress was bought by Infineon for €10 billion in 2020. Over the years, Spansion has accumulated numerous innovations and technological breakthroughs in memory, and its current products are generally marketed under the Spansion or Cypress names.

WPG expressed its pleasure in continuing the Spansion name to carry forward the related technology and industry mission, indicating that the acquisition not only expands its product and market footprint but also inherits the existing brand, technology, and customer assets.

WPG emphasized that the base price of the transaction is US$1.12 billion, but the final amount will be adjusted before closing according to the conditions set out in the share purchase agreement. The deal is slated for completion in the second half of 2027, subject to meeting all closing conditions, including obtaining the necessary regulatory approvals. Upon completion, WPG will directly or indirectly hold 100% of the target’s equity.

items.title: 〈鴻騰科技日〉盧松青：光通訊產能已備妥 最大瓶頸是材料供給
items.title_en: Foxconn Tech Day: Lu Songqing Says Optical‑Communication Capacity Is Ready, Material Supply Remains the Biggest Bottleneck
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)旗下鴻騰精密(FIT)(6088-HK)董事長盧松青今(16)日表示，目前光通訊最大的瓶頸仍是材料供給，包括Fiber、Laser、Chip、CW Laser及晶圓等都缺，材料已成為限制光通訊產業成長速度的關鍵因素。
盧松青指出，光通訊材料目前確實處於稀缺狀態，但問題在於技術路線尚未完全清晰，因此材料需求最終仍要看CSP決定採用哪一種技術方案。目前光通訊市場看起來相當複雜，「大家都有機會」，但最終仍要視市場及技術路線發展而定。
盧松青表示，鴻騰已經做好準備，目前已有一定的光通訊產品量，也有足夠產能預備在手上，不過，光通訊需求未來若以倍數方式成長，公司仍會觀察2027年初市場採用及需求，再適時做更大的投資布局。
盧松青表示，若上游材料出現缺口，鴻海集團也會考慮透過採購或投資方式確保供應，投資也不一定由鴻騰單獨進行，有時會與鴻海集團、工業富聯(FII)(601138-CN)共同投資相關標的，屬於集團整體策略。
盧松青指出，鴻海本身具備垂直整合優勢，上游有半導體等相關布局，鴻騰則位於中游，主要負責Module、Connector及Board；再往下游則有Switch、Architecture及機櫃等產品，涵蓋不同產品環節。
產能方面，盧松青表示，鴻騰目前在越南已有3座廠，最新的義安廠仍在興建中，規模也相當大，預期可支撐未來3至5年的需求，目前暫無進一步在其他東南亞國家建廠的規劃。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317‑TW) subsidiary FIT (Hong Teng Precision, 6088‑HK) chairman Lu Songqing said on the 16th that the biggest bottleneck in optical communications today is still material supply, with shortages of fiber, lasers, chips, CW lasers and wafers. Materials have become the key factor limiting the growth speed of the optical‑communication industry.

Lu noted that while optical‑communication materials are indeed scarce, the underlying issue is that the technology roadmap is not yet fully defined, so final material demand will depend on which solution CSPs choose. The market looks complex – “everyone has a chance” – but the outcome will ultimately be driven by market dynamics and the evolution of technology paths.

He added that Hong Teng is already prepared, with a certain volume of optical‑communication products and sufficient production capacity on hand. However, if demand grows exponentially, the company will monitor market adoption and demand in early 2027 before making larger investment commitments.

Lu said that if upstream material shortages arise, the Foxconn Group will consider securing supply through procurement or investment. Such investments may not be made by Hong Teng alone; sometimes they are undertaken jointly with Foxconn or its affiliate Foxconn Industrial Internet (FII, 601138‑CN) as part of a group‑wide strategy.

He pointed out that Foxconn itself enjoys vertical integration advantages, with upstream semiconductor and related assets, while Hong Teng sits in the mid‑stream, mainly handling modules, connectors and boards. Downstream are products such as switches, architecture solutions and rack systems, covering various segments of the value chain.

Regarding capacity, Lu said Hong Teng already operates three factories in Vietnam, with the newest Yi’an plant still under construction and of considerable size, expected to support demand for the next three to five years. There are currently no plans to build additional plants in other Southeast Asian countries.
