items.title: 〈鴻騰科技日〉盧松青：AI需求不錯產能滿載 光通訊產品明年進一步放量
items.title_en: Foxconn Tech Day – Lu Songqing: AI demand is solid, capacity fully utilized; optical communication products to ramp up further next year
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)旗下鴻騰精密(FIT)(6088-HK)董事長盧松青今(16)日表示，目前AI需求能見度仍好，整體產能相對滿載，延續至明年都不是問題；光通訊今年已經有產品進入，預期明年進一步放量。
鴻騰精密全球首席運營長兼首席財務長盧柏卿表示，光通訊產品雖然毛利率較高，但因目前營收基數仍不大，因此2026年對整體毛利率的影響非常小，2027年開始放量後，影響才會明顯增加。
盧柏卿指出，光通訊市場目前仍處於發展初期，未來成長速度仍取決於整體市場的採用程度，以及不同技術路線的發展，目前相關技術方案仍未完全定案。鴻騰目前已經做好準備，已有一定的量，產能也已預留。
在產品發展方面，盧松青表示，鴻騰在CPO可以從Chip-level切入，包括OE Engine Socket；若從板子直接接出來，則可提供Detachable Connector。目前相關產品仍沒有明確標準，公司也已與多方展開專案。
盧松青指出，從整體技術發展來看，CPO雖然被視為終極方向，但技術難度較高，NPO目前對客戶而言相對有把握；不同方案在Connection System、Support System及Thermal Solution上也有所差異，最終仍要看CSP採用方向。
盧柏卿指出，市場對光的採用並非20%、30%的成長，而是可能以倍數方式增加，因此公司將觀察2027年初整個產業對光的採用及需求程度，再適時做更大的投資布局。
盧松青表示，技術路線目前尚未完全明朗，但長期而言，隨著AI運算需求持續提升，走到後面一定需要光；現階段市場就像一個蹺蹺板，仍在銅與光之間尋找適合的技術方案。
paras_en: Hong Hai (2317-TW) subsidiary Hon Teng Precision (FIT) (6088-HK) chairman Lu Songqing said today (16) that AI demand visibility remains good, overall capacity is relatively fully utilized, and extending into next year is not a problem; optical communication already has products entering the market this year, and is expected to further scale up next year.

Hon Teng Precision global COO and CFO Lu Boqing said that although optical communication products have higher gross margins, because the current revenue base is still small, the impact on overall gross margin in 2026 will be very minimal; the impact will become noticeably larger after scaling up starting in 2027.

Lu Boqing noted that the optical communication market is still in its early development stage, and future growth speed depends on overall market adoption and the development of different technology routes; currently related technical solutions are not yet finalized. Hon Teng is already prepared, has a certain volume, and capacity has been reserved.

Regarding product development, Lu Songqing said Hon Teng can enter CPO from the chip level, including OE Engine Socket; if connecting directly from the board, it can provide Detachable Connector. Currently related products have no clear standards, and the company has already launched projects with multiple parties.

Lu Songqing pointed out that from overall technology development, CPO is seen as the ultimate direction but is technically more challenging, while NPO is currently more reliable for customers; different solutions also differ in Connection System, Support System, and Thermal Solution, and ultimately it depends on the CSP adoption direction.

Lu Boqing indicated that market adoption of optics is not a 20% or 30% growth, but could increase multiples; therefore the company will observe the industry's adoption and demand for optics in early 2027 and then make larger investment allocations in due time.

Lu Songqing said the technology routes are not yet fully clear, but in the long term, as AI computing demand continues to rise, optics will inevitably be needed later; currently the market is like a seesaw, still searching between copper and optics for suitable technology solutions.

items.title: 國科會：法令著重「人類自主」降低AI風險 首年已培育14萬AI人才達標
items.title_en: NSC: Laws Emphasize “Human Autonomy” to Reduce AI Risks, First Year Trains 140,000 AI Talent Meeting Target
paras: 國科會今(16)日召開第23次委員會議，由國發會報告「AI新十大建設推動方案-AI人才生態系推動情形」，展現政府整合教育、實作與全球攬才等建構AI人才生態系之階段性成果，目前台灣AI人才已達14萬人達標。另針對AI發展風險升溫，國科會主委吳誠文表示，AI基本法法令中以「人類自主」為原則，發展及應用應確保由人類掌握自主權，AI消滅人類僅為假議題。
國發會報告中指出，AI快速發展帶動人才需求攀升，政府擴大AI人才培育，規劃每年培育約10萬人次，目標在2028年可累計達40萬人次，今(2026)年已經超過原定目標，達到14萬人次，未來將從校園教育、產業訓練及全球攬才三方面布局，培養AI專業及跨域應用人才。
國發會說，面對全球AI浪潮及產業轉型需求，政府從校園育才到全球攬才，整合教育、產業與社會資源，打造支撐產業發展的AI人才生態系，如校園內，中小學強化AI素養及應用能力，大專院校則建置貼近產業需求的實作場域，鏈結教學能量與產業聚落，培育實戰型AI人才，並透過大專院校AI學程聯盟(TAICA)，整合跨校課程與師資資源。
校園外則推「AI產業人才認定指引3.0」，促進培訓、認證與企業用才需求接軌，並加強中小微企業AI人才培訓與導入應用支持，加速百工百業轉型及創新升級。
此外，近期國外科技業人士主張應放緩AI發展腳步，包括Anthropic新創公司的創辦人呼籲，AI可能對人類構成風險的憂慮升溫，應強制設置AI「緊急關機」機制。
吳誠文回應，目前「AI基本法」已納入7項基本原則及相關風險防範機制，其中「人類自主」是重要原則，發展及應用應確保由人類掌握自主權，並已透過相關機制降低潛在風險。
吳誠文強調，只要確實落實人類自主原則，並透過各種機制防範風險，AI消滅人類，他認為其實只是個假議題。
paras_en: The National Science Council held its 23rd committee meeting today (the 16th), where the National Development Council reported on the “Top Ten AI Construction Initiatives – AI Talent Ecosystem Promotion.” The report showcased the government’s phased achievements in building an AI talent ecosystem through integrated education, hands‑on practice, and global talent recruitment, noting that Taiwan now has 140,000 AI‑qualified personnel. Regarding rising AI‑related risks, NSC chair Wu Cheng‑wen said the AI Basic Law is founded on the principle of “human autonomy,” requiring that development and application remain under human control, and that the notion of AI wiping out humanity is a false issue.

The NDC report highlighted that rapid AI development is driving soaring talent demand. The government has expanded AI talent cultivation, planning to train about 100,000 people each year with a goal of reaching 400,000 cumulative trainees by 2028. In 2026, the target was already exceeded, achieving 140,000 trainees. Future efforts will be deployed across three fronts: campus education, industry training, and global talent recruitment, to nurture both AI specialists and cross‑disciplinary application experts.

The NDC explained that, in response to the global AI wave and industry transformation needs, the government is linking campus talent development with global recruitment, integrating education, industry, and societal resources to build an AI talent ecosystem that supports industrial growth. Within schools, primary and secondary education will strengthen AI literacy and application skills, while universities will establish practice‑oriented environments aligned with industry needs, linking teaching capacity with industrial clusters to produce battle‑ready AI talent. The university AI curriculum alliance (TAICA) will further integrate cross‑institution courses and faculty resources.

Outside the campus, the “AI Industry Talent Certification Guidelines 3.0” are being promoted to align training, certification, and corporate talent needs, while enhancing AI training and implementation support for small and micro‑enterprises, accelerating the transformation and innovative upgrading of all sectors of the economy.

In addition, recent comments from overseas tech industry figures have called for slowing AI development. The founder of the startup Anthropic, for example, warned that concerns about AI posing risks to humanity are intensifying and urged the mandatory implementation of an AI “emergency shut‑off” mechanism.

Wu Cheng‑wen responded that the current “AI Basic Law” already incorporates seven fundamental principles and related risk‑mitigation mechanisms, with “human autonomy” being a key principle. Development and application must ensure that humans retain control, and the law’s mechanisms have already reduced potential risks.

Wu Cheng‑wen emphasized that as long as the principle of human autonomy is genuinely implemented and various mechanisms are used to guard against risks, the idea that AI will eradicate humanity is, in his view, merely a false issue.

items.title: AI資料中心電力需求爆發 亞馬遜砸最高80億美元買發電機 Generac盤後飆逾40%
items.title_en: AI Data Center Power Demand Booms; Amazon Commits Up to $8 Billion for Generac Generators, Shares Surge Over 40% After Hours
paras: 亞馬遜(AMZN-US)周三(16日)宣布與發電設備製造商Generac Holdings(GNRC-US)簽署長期供應協議, 將向Generac採購備用發電機, 以支援旗下資料中心的電力需求。這項合作的潛在付款總額最高可達80億美元, 同時亞馬遜也取得購買Generac股票的認股權證, 消息公布後推升Generac股價, 盤後一度大漲超過40%。
根據Generac提交的監管文件, 亞馬遜旗下Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings取得認股權證, 最多可購買Generac 1,693,745股普通股, 執行價格為每股200.9266美元, 若全部行使, 認購金額約3.4億美元。
其中約307,954股認股權證股份立即歸屬, 其餘股份則將依亞馬遜及其關係企業未來向Generac支付的備用發電機款項, 按照累計付款金額分批歸屬。這意味著亞馬遜最終能夠取得多少Generac股份, 將與未來實際採購規模直接相關。
雙方此次簽署的長期供應協議, 初始訂單涉及2027年及2028年交付的備用發電機, 金額合計約24億美元。若後續採購持續增加, 整體供應協議的付款總額最高可達80億美元。
Generac股價周三正常交易收在175.11美元, 當日僅上漲0.05%, 但在雙方公布合作消息後, 盤後股價一度飆升超過40%, 盤後交易一度突破240美元, 隨後漲幅有所收斂。
亞馬遜此次採購與AI資料中心擴張有直接關聯。隨著生成式AI快速發展, 雲端運算及資料中心對電力需求持續增加, 大型科技公司除了需要取得穩定的電網供電, 也必須配置大型備用發電設備, 以避免電力中斷影響高價值運算設備及AI服務運作。
Generac是全球主要備用發電機製造商之一, 產品涵蓋住宅、商業及工業市場。近年AI資料中心快速擴張, 已使資料中心成為公司重要的成長市場。Generac也持續增加生產能力, 以因應大型資料中心客戶對兆瓦級備用發電設備的需求。
Generac此前曾表示, 資料中心業務的長期成長潛力強勁, 並預估到2028年資料中心相關銷售額可達10億美元。公司近年也投入約2.5億美元擴充產能, 並增加約1,000名員工, 以應付資料中
paras_en: Amazon (AMZN-US) announced on Wednesday (the 16th) that it has signed a long‑term supply agreement with generator maker Generac Holdings (GNRC-US) to purchase backup generators to support the power needs of its data centers. The potential total payment under the deal could reach as much as $8 billion, and Amazon also received warrants to buy Generac stock, which lifted Generac’s share price, spiking more than 40% in after‑hours trading.

According to regulatory filings submitted by Generac, Amazon’s subsidiary Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings obtained warrants to purchase up to 1,693,745 shares of Generac common stock at an exercise price of $200.9266 per share, which would amount to roughly $340 million if fully exercised.

About 307,954 of the warrant shares vest immediately, while the remaining shares will vest in tranches tied to the amount Amazon and its affiliates subsequently pay Generac for backup generators, based on cumulative payments. This means the ultimate number of Generac shares Amazon can acquire will be directly linked to the actual scale of future purchases.

The long‑term supply agreement’s initial orders cover backup generators to be delivered in 2027 and 2028, with a total value of about $2.4 billion. If subsequent purchases continue to grow, the overall contract’s payment ceiling could rise to as much as $8 billion.

Generac’s stock closed on Wednesday’s regular session at $175.11, up only 0.05% on the day, but after the partnership was announced the after‑hours price surged more than 40%, briefly breaking $240 before easing back.

Amazon’s procurement is directly tied to its expansion of AI data centers. As generative AI rapidly advances, cloud computing and data centers are seeing ever‑increasing power demand. Large tech firms not only need reliable grid power but also must equip massive backup generators to avoid outages that could disrupt high‑value computing equipment and AI services.

Generac is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of backup generators, serving residential, commercial and industrial markets. The rapid growth of AI data centers has made the data‑center segment a key growth market for the company, prompting Generac to expand production capacity to meet megawatt‑scale backup power needs of large‑scale data‑center customers.

Generac has previously said that the long‑term growth potential of its data‑center business is strong, projecting data‑center‑related sales to reach $1 billion by 2028. The company has invested roughly $250 million in recent years to expand capacity and added about 1,000 employees to handle the growing data‑center demand.

items.title: Fed升息1碼惹怒川普 喊話利率應降至1%以下
items.title_en: Fed Rate Hike Angers Trump, Calls for Rates Below 1%
paras: 聯準會 (Fed) 週三 (16 日) 宣布2023年以來首次升息後，美國總統川普隨即要求央行迅速將利率降至1%或更低。白宮亦批評這項決定「相當令人遺憾」，認為升息缺乏充分的經濟依據，但未直接批評Fed主席華許。
Fed稍早以12比0一致決議升息1碼，將聯邦資金利率目標區間調高至3.75%至4%。聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 在聲明中表示，通膨仍處於高檔；最新利率預測顯示，多數官員認為今年可能再次升息。
川普隨後在Truth Social發文表示，美國利率「應該降至1%或更低」，理由是美國擁有全球最佳信用。他並以全大寫文字要求：「為美國降低利率，而且要快！」
川普聲稱，美國正在支撐全球多數國家，這種情況不能繼續下去。他並以美國吸引大量新增投資，以及對許多國家存在貿易逆差為由，主張美國應適用更低利率。
白宮發言人德賽 (Kush Desai) 接受福斯新聞訪問時表示，川普已清楚說明希望利率朝哪個方向移動，而Fed當天決定升息，從政府立場來看「相當令人遺憾」，也缺乏特別有力的經濟依據。
德賽指出，目前並非拜登政府時期，川普與共和黨沒有投入數兆美元的新冠疫情刺激支出，因此不存在需要透過提高利率加以抑制的失控總需求。
儘管白宮反對這次升息，德賽仍表示，川普相信Fed應保持獨立，但這不影響總統在認為政策出現問題時公開表達意見的權利。
川普近期已重新加大對Fed的施壓力道。不到兩週前，他曾警告，如果Fed不降息，可能停止與對美國享有貿易順差的國家進行貿易，涉及美國多數主要貿易夥伴及其他數十個國家。
不過，川普與白宮官員目前仍未直接抨擊由川普任命的華許。華許接替鮑爾出任Fed主席後，川普對央行的公開施壓一度減弱，如今情況可能隨著Fed轉向升息而改變，華許也將面臨更大的白宮政治壓力。
paras_en: The Federal Reserve announced on Wednesday the 16th that it had raised rates for the first time since 2023, prompting President Trump to immediately demand that the central bank swiftly cut rates to 1% or lower. The White House also criticized the decision as "quite regrettable," saying the hike lacked sufficient economic justification, though it did not directly criticize Fed Chair Jerome Powell.

Earlier that day, the Fed voted unanimously 12‑0 to raise rates by one quarter point, moving the federal funds target range to 3.75%‑4%. In its statement, the Federal Open Market Committee said inflation remains high; the latest rate forecasts show most officials think another hike could be possible this year.

Trump then posted on Truth Social that U.S. rates "should be cut to 1% or lower," arguing that the United States has the best credit in the world. He wrote in all‑caps: "Lower rates for America, and do it fast!"

Trump claimed the United States is supporting most of the world’s economies and that this situation cannot continue. Citing the influx of new investment into the U.S. and large trade deficits with many countries, he argued that America should enjoy lower rates.

White House spokesperson Kush Desai told Fox News that Trump has made clear the direction he wants rates to move, and that the Fed’s decision to raise rates that day was "quite regrettable" from the government’s perspective and lacked particularly strong economic justification.

Desai noted that this is not the Biden administration era; Trump and the Republican Party have not poured trillions of dollars into COVID‑19 stimulus, so there is no runaway aggregate demand that needs to be curbed by higher rates.

Although the White House opposes the hike, Desai said Trump believes the Fed should remain independent, and that does not prevent the president from publicly voicing his opinion when he thinks policy is wrong.

Trump has recently stepped up pressure on the Fed again. Less than two weeks ago he warned that if the Fed does not cut rates, he could halt trade with countries that run trade surpluses with the United States, affecting most of America’s major trading partners and dozens of other nations.

However, neither Trump nor White House officials have directly attacked Powell, who was appointed by Trump. After Powell succeeded Jerome Powell as Fed chair, Trump’s public pressure on the central bank had eased, but the situation may change as the Fed moves toward hikes, and Powell could face greater political pressure from the White House.

items.title: 英特爾上漲4% 投資人盼記憶體晶片成轉型下一步
items.title_en: Intel Rises 4% as Investors Hope Memory Chips Are the Next Step in Its Transformation
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，英特爾(Intel)(INTC-US)的起源可追溯到記憶體晶片業務，但由於經濟效益不佳，公司後來退出了這項業務。不過，隨著記憶體晶片市場再次熱絡，投資人期待英特爾能重新參與其中。
英特爾股價周三上漲4%。
據《路透社》昨夜消息，英特爾正在與SK海力士(SK Hynix)(SKHY-US)進行討論。這家南韓晶片製造商正考慮於美國生產記憶體晶片。
報導指出，SK海力士的選項包括租用英特爾位於俄亥俄州一座規劃中的廠房部分設施，或與英特爾及其他公司成立合資企業。
消息指出，目前雙方的討論仍處於「探索階段」，最終不一定會形成商業合作關係。此外，南韓政府可能反對這類合作。
英特爾發言人表示，「作為公司政策，我們不會針對媒體對未來商業安排的猜測發表評論。不過，英特爾致力於俄亥俄州，我們也持續投資，以加快該基地的建設準備工作。」
英特爾目前並不銷售記憶體晶片，但公司確實提供晶片製造產能。大多數美國晶片公司都將半導體製造外包給台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)。但英特爾同時具備自行製造晶片的能力，也有能力為其晶圓代工部門爭取具規模的業務，該部門負責替其他業界公司製造晶片。
英特爾正處於一場復興之中，公司已獲得美國政府與輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)的投資，同時人工智慧也正重新點燃其業務成長。
隨著新型AI工作負載需要更多CPU，英特爾用於伺服器的CPU已成為市場熱門商品。
這代表AI產業的敘事出現轉變。早期的AI發展敘事中，相較於輝達生產的GPU等產品，CPU的重要性較低。
記憶體晶片則是AI硬體市場中另一個熱門領域。目前只有少數幾家公司能夠生產記憶體晶片，且其生產速度仍不足以滿足從事資料密集型工作負載的AI公司強勁需求。
即使企業決定擴大產能，也需要時間才能真正增加製造能力。而目前主要業者確實都有提升產能的計畫，但同時對擴產保持審慎態度。
paras_en: MarketWatch reports that Intel’s origins trace back to the memory‑chip business, but poor economics led the company to exit that segment. Now, with the memory market heating up again, investors are hoping Intel will re‑enter it.
Intel’s stock jumped 4% on Wednesday.
According to Reuters last night, Intel is in talks with SK Hynix. The South Korean chipmaker is considering producing memory chips in the United States.
The report says SK Hynix’s options include leasing part of Intel’s planned Ohio fab or forming a joint venture with Intel and other partners.
Sources say the discussions are still in an “exploratory” phase and may not result in a commercial deal, and the South Korean government could oppose such cooperation.

An Intel spokesperson said, “As company policy we do not comment on media speculation about future business arrangements. However, Intel is committed to Ohio and continues to invest to accelerate the site’s build‑out preparation.”

Intel does not currently sell memory chips, but it does offer chip‑manufacturing capacity. Most U.S. chip firms outsource semiconductor production to TSMC, yet Intel both manufactures its own chips and can secure sizable business for its foundry services that produce chips for other companies.
Intel is in the midst of a revival, having secured investment from the U.S. government and Nvidia, while artificial intelligence is reigniting its growth prospects.
As new AI workloads demand more CPUs, Intel’s server CPUs have become hot commodities in the market.
This signals a shift in the AI narrative. In early AI stories, CPUs were seen as less important compared to Nvidia’s GPUs and similar products.

Memory chips are another hot segment of the AI hardware market. Only a handful of firms can produce them, and current production speeds fall short of the strong demand from data‑intensive AI workloads.

Even when companies decide to expand capacity, it takes time to truly increase manufacturing output. While the major players do have plans to boost capacity, they remain cautious about rapid expansion.

items.title: 速度快200倍、成本降400倍！前OpenAI研究員閉關兩年 推出LLM新模型Jev
items.title_en: 200× Faster, 400× Cheaper! Former OpenAI Researcher Returns After Two Years with New LLM Model Jev
paras: 發明ChatGPT的核心科學家閉關兩年後，反手給整個大模型行業敲了一錘喪鐘。前OpenAI核心研究員，ChatGPT、GPT-4論文重要貢獻者，現TypeSafe創始人Diogo Almeida公布了一種全新模型：Jev，在開發者圈迅速走紅。
Jev這個名字取自傑文斯悖論（Jevons paradox），同時寓意它在「每美元所能換取的智慧」指標上表現爆表。
與現有的LLM模型相比，Jev在系統任務上達到了類似的智慧水平，但速度和效率提高了兩個數量級，雖然Jev不具備字符串生成功能，但它針對結構化輸出進行了優化，並且不會產生幻覺。
Diogo Almeida稱團隊歷時兩年「秘密」研發，構建了一個完全專注於自動化的新堆棧：採用新的模型架構、並行採樣器以實現最高效率，以及一種新的模型訓練方法（RLCD）。
簡單來說就是，開發者可以把Jev看作是一個前沿智慧函數調用：輸入非結構化狀態，輸出類型化的概率決策。
在所有人的慣性思維裡，大模型必須會出口成章、會長篇大論，但Jev走向了完全相反的方向——它徹底閹割了自然語言生成能力，絕不吐半句廢話，只在毫秒級內給出最精準的概率分布與結構化判定。
Diogo Almeida介紹，相比現有的LLM模型，Jev速度快20-200倍，成本低40-400倍（輸出令牌免費），聽起來好得令人難以置信。
成本方面，LLM模型輸入token約0.20-10美元/百萬token，輸出開銷約為輸入token的5倍，而Jev輸入token為0.042美元/百萬token（即每十億token42美元），輸出token不計費（成本極低，無需計量）。
訓練優化方式方面，LLM模型普遍基於人類反饋的強化學習（RLHF）/可驗證獎勵強化學習（RLVR）；Jev的訓練方法為校準決策強化學習（RLCD）。
速度方面，先進模型端到端響應時間：3-329秒，對人機互動尚可，但嵌入程式碼時會成為巨大性能瓶頸；Jev模型的端到端響應為70-500毫秒，針對系統一類任務，同等智慧水平下，速度提升40-200倍。
Jev模型可用於四類場景：
1、AI驅動業務流程／智慧條件判斷。結構化輸出直接接入普通軟體，充當模糊決策規則：分類、路由、打分、資訊提取、分支判斷；替代難以維護的手寫邏輯；程式碼約束模型輸出邊界，更容易構建穩定可靠系統。
2、大數據Map-Reduce處理：PB級數據提取特徵、挖掘洞察。
3、實時應用：100ms級別延遲，可用於對互動體驗要求嚴苛的產品。
4、全鏈路校驗：打分、評判、核驗、安全防護，以及檢測大模型提示詞越獄、推理鏈路、模型輸出的安全風險。
這種性能說出來可能沒人信，該團隊在技術報告中表示歡迎質疑者自行驗證。
官方對照Demo直觀展現了Jev模型與傳統LLM模型的核心差異：Jev會並行輸出全部概率結果，而不是按token自回歸逐個生成，幾乎秒出結果；普通LLM字符串文本生成雖然能力極強、通用性高，但代價高昂。
在這個示例中，該團隊選用的對照模型是默認配置的GPT-5.6 Terra，原因是它的平均智慧水平與目前的Jev最為接近。
此外，該團隊還設計了一套新的評測方式，用來衡量AI在程式碼內部的實際運行效果。
具體而言，預先設定一套正確的計算圖（以程式碼實現的「工作流」），並把業界規模最大、能力最強、成本最高的外部大模型給出的預測結果，作為參考概率基準。
所有模型運行完全相同的工作流，測試各個模型與頂尖模型集合的平均輸出之間的差距，選用的基準模型為當下的旗艦模型GPT-6 Astra與Claude Fable 5.1。
Jev的表現遠超預期，佔據帕累托最優前沿，性能差距接近兩個數量級，而依靠生成提示詞、把全部邏輯放在思維鏈（CoT）內部完成推理的模型，表現明顯劣於直接使用工作流本身。
另一大突出優勢在於幻覺與類型安全方面。代理場景下，發生幻覺導致工具調用出錯頂多帶來使用不便，但如果這套系統有延遲保障要求，或是調用鏈路深埋在多層依賴鏈之中，幻覺問題就會直接讓整套系統徹底不可用。
現有的大模型，最讓人抓馬的死穴是它有時候會在不知道答案時依然選擇自信地「胡說八道」，無論如今能力有多強，依然會有概率產生幻覺，同時還會出現類型錯誤。
而Jev模型輸出的每一個數值和選項，都帶著嚴格校準後的真實勝率與置信度，它很清楚自己知不知道，在數學層面上把幻覺徹底焊死降為0。
paras_en: After two years of seclusion, the core scientist who invented ChatGPT has dealt a death blow to the entire large‑model industry. Former OpenAI core researcher and key contributor to the ChatGPT and GPT‑4 papers, now founder of TypeSafe Diogo Almeida, announced a brand‑new model called Jev, which quickly went viral in developer circles.
The name Jev comes from Jevons paradox and also implies that it blows past the metric of “intelligence per dollar”.

Compared with existing LLMs, Jev reaches a comparable level of intelligence on system‑level tasks but is two orders of magnitude faster and more efficient. Although Jev lacks free‑form string generation, it is optimized for structured output and does not hallucinate.

Diogo Almeida said the team spent two years in “secret” development to build a stack focused entirely on automation: a new model architecture, a parallel sampler for maximum efficiency, and a novel training method called RLCD.
In simple terms, developers can think of Jev as a cutting‑edge intelligent function call: it takes unstructured input and returns typed probabilistic decisions.

Conventional wisdom holds that large models must produce fluent prose and long passages, but Jev goes in the opposite direction—it completely disables natural‑language generation, never spews filler, and delivers the most precise probability distribution and structured judgment within milliseconds.
Almeida claims Jev is 20‑200× faster than current LLMs and 40‑400× cheaper (output tokens are free), sounding almost too good to be true.

In cost terms, typical LLMs charge about $0.20‑$10 per million input tokens and output costs are roughly five times the input cost. Jev charges $0.042 per million input tokens (about $42 per billion tokens) and does not bill for output tokens, making its cost negligible.
Regarding training, most LLMs rely on reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) or verifiable reward RL (RLVR). Jev is trained with calibrated‑decision reinforcement learning (RLCD).

Speed-wise, state‑of‑the‑art models have end‑to‑end latencies of 3‑329 seconds, which is acceptable for human‑machine interaction but becomes a bottleneck when embedded in code. Jev’s end‑to‑end latency is 70‑500 ms, giving a 40‑200× speed boost for system‑type tasks at comparable intelligence.
Jev can be applied in four categories of scenarios:

1. AI‑driven business processes and intelligent conditional judgments. Structured outputs plug directly into ordinary software, acting as fuzzy decision rules for classification, routing, scoring, information extraction, branch decisions; they replace hard‑to‑maintain hand‑written logic; code‑constrained model outputs are easier to build into stable, reliable systems.
2. Big‑data Map‑Reduce processing: extracting features and insights from petabyte‑scale datasets.
3. Real‑time applications: 100 ms‑level latency suitable for products with strict interaction‑experience requirements.
4. End‑to‑end verification: scoring, judging, validating, security protection, and detecting prompt jailbreaks, reasoning chain issues, and safety risks in model outputs.
The performance sounds unbelievable, but the team states in its technical report that skeptics are welcome to verify it themselves.

The official demo visually contrasts Jev with traditional LLMs: Jev outputs all probability results in parallel instead of generating tokens autoregressively one by one, delivering results almost instantly; conventional LLMs excel at free‑form text generation but at a high cost.
In the demo, the baseline model is the default‑configuration GPT‑5.6 Terra, chosen because its average intelligence level is closest to the current Jev.
The team also devised a new evaluation method to measure AI’s actual runtime effect inside code.

Specifically, they pre‑define a correct computation graph (a “workflow” implemented in code) and use the predictions of the industry’s largest, most capable, and most expensive external LLM as a reference probability baseline.
All models run the identical workflow, and the gap between each model’s average output and the top‑model ensemble is measured; the benchmark models are the flagship GPT‑6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1.

Jev’s performance far exceeds expectations, occupying the Pareto‑optimal frontier with a performance gap of nearly two orders of magnitude. Models that rely on prompt generation and keep all reasoning inside a chain‑of‑thought (CoT) perform noticeably worse than using the workflow directly.

Another major advantage is in hallucination and type safety. In agent scenarios, hallucinations that cause tool‑call errors may be merely inconvenient, but if the system requires latency guarantees or the call chain is buried deep in multiple dependencies, hallucinations can render the entire system unusable.

Existing large models’ biggest flaw is that they sometimes confidently “make stuff up” when they don’t know the answer; no matter how capable they become, they still have a non‑zero probability of hallucinating and can produce type errors.
Every value and option output by Jev carries a rigorously calibrated real‑world win rate and confidence level; it knows whether it knows, and mathematically eliminates hallucinations to zero.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走強 Fed升息1碼
items.title_en: <New York FX> Dollar Strengthens as Fed Raises Rates by One Quarter Point
paras: 美元周三(16日)進一步走高，美國聯準會(Fed)三年多來首次升息，美元連續第六個交易日上漲。另一方面，英鎊在英國政府數據顯示8月消費者通膨加速後走弱。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.4%，報99.89。
聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)周三如市場普遍預期升息，這也是自2023年7月以來首次收緊貨幣政策。同時，聯準會最新的「點陣圖」顯示，官員預測今年還會再升息一次。
FOMC一致投票決定，將聯邦資金利率從3.50%-3.75%上調至3.75%-4.00%。
在周三聯準會公布利率決策之前，市場對升息的預期一直穩步升溫，部分原因是美國經濟數據顯示經濟成長具韌性、勞動市場強勁，以及通膨維持偏高。
聯準會偏好的最新通膨指標——個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數——顯示年增3.7%，遠高於聯準會長期設定的2%目標。事實上，PCE已經連續65個月高於2%。
與經濟數據，以及中東衝突擴大導致油價再次上漲相比，美國債券市場可能是推升升息預期的最大因素。
自聯準會7月會議左右開始，美國債券市場便陷入持續不斷的拋售，尤其是較長天期債券，導致美國公債殖利率飆升至多年甚至數十年來的高點。
這波債券拋售起初是因為三位地區聯準銀行總裁不同意FOMC在7月維持利率不變的決定，反而主張升息，這顯示固定收益市場的交易員對聯準會打擊通膨的努力並不滿意。
到了8月，隨著油價飆升、市場擔心數十億美元資金持續投入AI基礎建設，以及美國財政債務不斷膨脹，債券拋售進一步加劇。
美國10年期公債殖利率周二創下2007年4月以來最高水準。10年期公債殖利率是房貸、企業債務及學生貸款等各類借貸的重要基準，30年期公債殖利率也創下超過24年來的新高。
現在外匯市場關注的問題是：今天市場預期中的升息究竟會是「升一次就結束」，還是會成為新一輪升息周期的開始？
根據CME FedWatch工具，市場參與者預期今年至少還會有一次25個基點的升息。
在這樣的背景下，市場將密切關注聯準會最新發布的經濟預測摘要，以了解未來貨幣政策的方向。
同時，華許和聯準會也面臨要求降息的政治壓力，其中最明顯的來自美國總統川普。
Wilsey Asset Management投資長Brent Wilsey表示，「聯準會正面臨來自債券市場的升息壓力，因為一般而言，聯邦資金利率不會長期維持在遠低於債券殖利率的水準。」
他補充，「如果聯準會周三決定維持利率不變，可能會讓市場感到意外……而市場通常不會很好的接受意外情況。這也可能損害聯準會的公信力，並重新引發外界對聯準會是否屈服於政治壓力、選擇維持利率不變的疑慮。」
英國年度CPI增幅創3月以來最高
英鎊周三成為市場焦點，下跌0.2%，至1英鎊兌1.3447美元。
稍早，英國國家統計局公布，英國8月消費者物價指數(CPI)年增3.1%，高於7月的2.9%，也是自3月的3.3%以來最高。
以月增率來看，8月CPI上升0.5%，高於7月的0.3%。交通價格，尤其是汽油等車用燃料價格，對年度CPI增幅的推升幅度最大，反映出中東持續衝突導致全球油價飆升。比較正面的訊號是，英國8月核心CPI年增2.6%，與7月持平。
這份通膨數據公布的隔天，就是英格蘭銀行(BoE)公布利率決策的日子。市場普遍預期英格蘭銀行將維持利率不變。
不過，利率交換市場交易員目前認為，英格蘭銀行進行25個基點升息的機率約為三分之一。此外，市場也大致已消化今年年底前還會再升息一次的預期。
德意志銀行首席英國經濟學家Sanjay Raja表示，「對英格蘭銀行而言，要讓通膨維持在2%的工作已經變得更加困難。我們自己的預測顯示，CPI很可能在年初年末交界附近接近4%。」
「利率可能已經具有抑制效果，但貨幣政策委員會面臨的關鍵政策問題仍是：目前的限制程度是否足夠？風險管理方面的考量已經變得更加重要，而近期升息的可能性也有所提高。」

paras_en: The dollar rose further on Wednesday (the 16th), marking the Fed's first rate hike in over three years, and the dollar has been up for six consecutive trading days. Meanwhile, the pound weakened after UK government data showed accelerated consumer inflation in August.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, rose 0.4% to 99.89.

The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) raised rates on Wednesday as broadly expected, marking the first tightening of monetary policy since July 2023. At the same time, the Fed's latest dot‑plot shows officials anticipate one more hike this year.
The FOMC voted unanimously to raise the federal funds rate range from 3.50%‑3.75% to 3.75%‑4.00%.

Before the Fed announced its rate decision on Wednesday, market expectations for a hike had been steadily warming, partly because U.S. economic data showed resilient growth, a strong labor market, and inflation remaining elevated.

The Fed's preferred inflation gauge, the personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index, showed a 3.7% year‑over‑year increase, far above the Fed’s long‑run 2% target. In fact, PCE has been above 2% for 65 consecutive months.
Compared with the economic data and the renewed Middle‑East conflict that pushed oil prices higher again, the U.S. bond market may be the biggest driver of the rising rate‑hike expectations.

Since around the Fed’s July meeting, the U.S. bond market has been in a relentless sell‑off, especially in longer‑dated securities, sending Treasury yields soaring to multi‑year, even multi‑decade highs.

The bond sell‑off initially stemmed from three regional Fed bank presidents who disagreed with the FOMC’s decision to keep rates unchanged in July and instead advocated a hike, indicating fixed‑income traders were dissatisfied with the Fed’s inflation‑fighting efforts.
By August, the sell‑off intensified as oil prices surged, markets worried about billions of dollars flowing into AI infrastructure, and U.S. fiscal debt continued to expand.

U.S. 10‑year Treasury yields hit their highest level since April 2007 on Tuesday. The 10‑year yield is a key benchmark for mortgages, corporate debt and student loans, while the 30‑year yield also reached a 24‑year high.
The forex market now focuses on whether today’s anticipated hike will be a one‑off “stop‑after‑one” move or the start of a new tightening cycle.
According to the CME FedWatch tool, market participants expect at least one more 25‑basis‑point hike this year.
Against this backdrop, markets will watch the Fed’s latest Summary of Economic Projections closely to gauge the future direction of policy.
At the same time, both the Fed and Treasury face political pressure to cut rates, most visibly from President Trump.

Wilsey Asset Management’s chief investment officer Brent Wilsey said, “The Fed is under rate‑hike pressure from the bond market because, generally, the federal funds rate does not stay far below bond yields for long.”

He added, “If the Fed decided to keep rates unchanged on Wednesday, it could surprise the market… and markets typically do not react well to surprises. That could also damage the Fed’s credibility and revive doubts about whether the Fed is yielding to political pressure by holding rates steady.”
UK annual CPI rise hits highest level since March
The pound became a market focus on Wednesday, slipping 0.2% to $1.3447 per pound.
Earlier, the UK Office for National Statistics reported that August CPI rose 3.1% year‑over‑year, up from 2.9% in July and the highest since March’s 3.3%.

On a monthly basis, August CPI rose 0.5%, above July’s 0.3%. Transport prices, especially gasoline and other vehicle fuels, drove the biggest annual CPI increase, reflecting global oil price spikes from the ongoing Middle‑East conflict. A brighter note is that core CPI for August was up 2.6% year‑over‑year, unchanged from July.
The day after this inflation data is the Bank of England’s rate‑decision day. Markets broadly expect the BoE to keep rates unchanged.
However, rate‑swap traders currently see about a one‑in‑three chance of a 25‑basis‑point BoE hike. The market has also largely priced in another hike before year‑end.

Deutsche Bank’s chief UK economist Sanjay Raja said, “For the BoE, keeping inflation at 2% is becoming increasingly difficult. Our own forecasts suggest CPI could be near 4% around the turn of the year.”

“Rates may already be having a restraining effect, but the key policy question for the Monetary Policy Committee remains: is the current level of restriction sufficient? Risk‑management considerations are becoming more important, and the likelihood of a near‑term hike has risen.”

paras: 美股主要指數週三 (16 日) 震盪收黑，聯準會 (Fed) 如預期升息 1 碼，並暗示今年可能再次升息。美股在決策公布後一度走高，但隨主席華許重申抗通膨立場，市場對後續緊縮幅度的疑慮升溫，道瓊終場急瀉逾 630 點，收在 6 月 12 日以來最低水準，標普 500 指數翻黑0.45%，寫下自7月31日以來最低收盤價。
聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 週三以 12 比 0 全票通過升息 1 碼，將聯邦資金利率目標區間調高至 3.75%至4%，為 2023 年 7 月以來首次升息。
Fed 在會後聲明中表示，通膨仍處於高檔，此次政策行動將有助於通膨更及時地回到 2%目標。最新點狀圖顯示，多數官員預期今年仍可能再升息一次。
Fed 主席華許將此次升息形容為「撤回部分寬鬆政策」，引發市場擔憂Fed仍認為金融情勢偏寬鬆，政策利率可能需要進一步上調。貨幣市場反映，Fed在10月會議再度升息的機率約為50%。
美國總統川普隨後發文指出，美國利率應降至1%甚至更低，並再次敦促聯準會快速降息。
受華許「鷹訊」衝擊，美債殖利率同步攀升，2 年期殖利率升至 2024 年以來高點，10 年期殖利率重返 5% 上方，創 2007 年 7 月 19 日以來最高，黃金跳水，美元走強，顯示市場重新評估 Fed 未來的利率路徑。

華邦電子11.2億美元拿下英飛凌NOR Flash、F-RAM業務，英飛凌ADR (IFNNY-US) 週三早盤走升，尾盤隨大盤下滑，收跌0.41% 至每股 62.40 美元。
馬斯克關於人工智慧 (AI) 晶片的警告，再次引發人們對台灣供應風險的關注。 馬斯克稱：「未來某個時點晶片可能無法再持續從台灣運往美國，若沒有足夠晶片，AI、人形機器人與電動車擴張都可能面臨困境」。台積電ADR (TSM-US) 揚升超1% 至每股 417.72 美元。
經濟數據
美國8月零售銷售月增1.2%，高於市場預期的0.9%，扭轉7月下滑0.5%的表現，顯示儘管通膨侵蝕購買力，消費支出仍保持韌性。強勁的消費數據與Fed對經濟活動的正面評估，進一步削弱市場對Fed迅速停止升息的期待。
華爾街分析
Principal Asset Management全球策略師Seema Shah表示，市場辯論焦點如今已從「Fed是否再次升息」，轉向「後續還有幾次升息」。
她指出，FOMC全票通過升息，顯示能源價格上漲及通膨居高不下，已促使立場偏鴿的官員支持採取行動，因此本次升息不太可能是一次性措施。
Evercore策略師Krishna Guha認為，華許在記者會上的表現連貫且立場明確，整體維持鷹派，但又不至於過度激進。不過，他認為華許所稱「撤回部分寬鬆政策」，可能使市場更難判斷Fed最終需要把利率升至多高。
高盛資產管理固定收益與流動性解決方案全球主管暨投資長 Kay Haigh 表示：「Fed 已釋出訊號，現階段並未考慮展開激進的升息循環。根據經濟預測摘要 (SEP)，多數FOMC官員預期今年合計升息兩次；鑑於 10 月會議距離期中選舉時間太近，Fed 很可能暫停升息。
Haigh 指出：「基本預測是 Fed 將於 12 月再升息一次，但最終仍取決於接下來公布的消費者物價指數 (CPI) 數據及能源價格走勢。」
數字皆為截稿前更新，請依照實際報價為主
paras_en: US major indices were volatile on Wednesday (16th), closing lower as the Federal Reserve (Fed) raised rates by 25 basis points as expected and hinted at further hikes this year. The market initially rallied after the decision, but concerns over the Fed’s continued tightening grew when Chair Jerome Powell reiterated his anti‑inflation stance, causing the Dow to fall more than 630 points to its lowest level since June 12, while the S&P 500 slipped 0.45% to a closing low not seen since July 31.
The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) voted 12‑to‑0 to raise the federal funds target range by 25 basis points to 3.75%‑4%, the first rate increase since July 2023.

In its post‑meeting statement, the Fed said inflation remains high and that this policy action will help bring inflation back to the 2% target more promptly. A recent dot plot shows most officials expect another rate hike this year.

Chair Powell described the increase as a "partial rollback of accommodative policy," sparking market worries that the Fed still views the financial environment as overly loose and that rates may need to rise further. Money markets reflected a roughly 50% chance of another hike at the October meeting.
Former President Trump posted that U.S. rates should fall to 1% or lower and again urged the Fed to cut rates quickly.

Powell’s hawkish tone pushed Treasury yields higher: the 2‑year yield hit a 2024 high, the 10‑year returned above 5% for the first time since July 19, 2007, gold fell, and the dollar strengthened, indicating a reassessment of the Fed’s future rate path.

Brent crude futures fell about 3% to $105.48 a barrel; WTI fell about 3.6% to $102.04 a barrel. Saudi Arabia is shipping more crude to Asian refineries via a ship‑to‑ship transfer off Oman’s Sohar port, and U.S. crude inventories unexpectedly rose, easing some supply‑disruption concerns.
US major indices on Wednesday (16th):

The Dow Industrial Index fell 631.21 points, or 1.21%, to 51,461.90. The Nasdaq fell 3.15 points, or 0.01%, to 25,978.43. The S&P 500 fell 33.92 points, or 0.45%, to 7,551.81. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose 70.56 points, or 0.63%, to 11,246.11. The NYSE FANG+ Index fell 39.34 points, or 0.21%, to 18,466.04.
In the NYSE FANG+ tech giants, Meta (META‑US) rose 0.46%; Apple (AAPL‑US) rose 0.32%; Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) fell 0.61%; Microsoft (MSFT‑US) fell 1.37%; Amazon (AMZN‑US) fell 0.99%.

The Philadelphia semiconductor group saw mixed moves: AMD (AMD‑US) rose 1.65%; Broadcom (AVGO‑US) rose 0.07%; NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) rose 0.82%; Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) fell 1.37%; Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) fell 1.58%.
Memory stocks were mixed: Western Digital (WDC‑US) rose 1.22%; Seagate (STX‑US) rose 1.47%; Micron fell 0.11%; SanDisk (SNDK‑US) fell 0.71%; SK Hynix ADR (SKHY‑US) rose 0.02%.
Taiwan ADRs led with UMC: TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) rose 1.23%; ASE (ASX‑US) rose 2.24%; UMC ADR (UMC‑US) rose 4.26%; Chunghwa Telecom ADR (CHT‑US) fell 0.42%.
Corporate news:

SpaceX (SPCX‑US) surged over 5% to $150.88 a share. SpaceX announced its next Starship test flight will be on September 22, the first attempt to reach Earth orbit, marking the start of a new phase toward fully reusable Starships.
Apple (AAPL‑US) closed up 0.32% at $332.41 a share. Apple is reportedly developing enterprise servers with its own chips and has discussed using NVIDIA’s networking equipment.
SK Hynix ADR (SKHY‑US) edged up 0.023% to $174.87 a share, while Intel (INTC‑US) jumped over 4% to $101.05 a share.

Foreign media reported early Wednesday that SK Hynix and Intel were negotiating an agreement to produce memory in the U.S. for the first time, but SK Hynix later said there was no definitive conclusion.
Wang Labs secured $112 million for Infineon’s NOR Flash and F‑RAM businesses; Infineon ADR (IFNNY‑US) opened higher but fell 0.41% to $62.40 a share by the close.

Elon Musk’s warning about AI chips has reignited concerns over Taiwan supply risks. Musk said that at some point chips may no longer be shipped from Taiwan to the U.S., jeopardizing AI, humanoid robots, and EV expansion. TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) rose over 1% to $417.72 a share.
Economic data:

U.S. August retail sales rose 1.2% month‑over‑month, beating the 0.9% forecast and reversing July’s 0.5% decline, showing that consumer spending remains resilient despite inflation eroding purchasing power. Strong consumer data and the Fed’s positive view of economic activity further weakened expectations for a rapid pause in rate hikes.
Wall Street analysts:
Principal Asset Management global strategist Seema Shah said the market debate has shifted from whether the Fed will hike again to how many hikes remain.
She noted that the FOMC’s unanimous vote shows that rising energy prices and persistent inflation have persuaded dovish officials to act, making this hike unlikely to be a one‑off.

Evercore strategist Krishna Guha said Powell’s press conference was consistent and hawkish but not overly aggressive. He added that Powell’s call for a partial rollback of accommodative policy may make it harder for markets to gauge the Fed’s ultimate rate target.

Goldman Sachs Asset Management fixed‑income and liquidity solutions global head and CIO Kay Haigh said the Fed has signaled it is not pursuing an aggressive hike cycle. According to the SEP, most FOMC officials expect two hikes this year; given the October meeting is close to the midterm election, the Fed is likely to pause.
Haigh added that the basic forecast is a December hike, but the final decision will depend on upcoming CPI data and energy price trends.

items.title: Altman確定出席川習國宴 OpenAI躋身美中峰會科技焦點
items.title_en: Altman Confirms Attendance at Trump State Dinner for Xi, OpenAI Becomes Tech Focus at US‑China Summit
paras: OpenAI週三(16日)表示，執行長Sam Altman將出席美國總統川普為中國國家主席習近平舉行的國宴。路透報導指出，這項消息最早由CNN披露，Altman此行也使美中領袖峰會期間，美國科技產業高層的參與受到關注。
川普預定9月24日在華盛頓與習近平會面，雙方將舉行峰會。此次國宴屬於川普為習近平訪美安排的重要外交活動，而OpenAI執行長Altman確認出席，顯示美國人工智慧產業領袖將參與這場涉及美中關係與科技議題的重要場合。
除了Altman之外，輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳也預計出席川普為習近平舉行的國宴。路透引述知情人士報導，黃仁勳將參加這場活動；黃仁勳近年已成為全球AI產業的重要代表人物，而輝達則是向人工智慧開發商供應高階晶片的主要企業之一。
此次科技業高層出席的背景，也與近期美中雙方對人工智慧發展速度、安全風險及監管方式的討論升溫有關。路透稍早報導，美中正籌備人工智慧安全對話，雙方曾討論監測AI主導的網路攻擊，以及由美中AI實驗室分享資訊、共同降低相關風險等議題。
路透9月4日報導指出，這場AI安全對話原先規劃於9月中旬舉行，並被視為川普與習近平9月24日華盛頓峰會可能涉及的議題之一。美方希望討論AI相關網路攻擊的監控合作，並曾提出由美中AI實驗室自行監督、分享資訊，以防範AI相關網路攻擊的構想。
AI安全議題近期在美國也持續升溫。Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei日前呼籲放慢前沿AI發展速度，讓安全措施有更多時間跟上技術進步，OpenAI執行長Altman及其他科技業領袖也曾公開表示支持相關討論。不過，川普對放慢AI發展的主張持不同看法，強調美國需要維持相對中國的AI競爭優勢。
中國方面則對美國科技業要求放慢AI發展的部分主張提出質疑。中國官媒《環球時報》日前曾批評Amodei要求放慢AI發展的主張，認為相關倡議涉及對中國科技發展的限制。北京同時表示，各方應透過合作推動AI治理，而非透過對抗或競爭處理相關問題。
美中雙方近期也面臨AI快速發展帶來的實際安全事件。路透此前報導，近700個以OpenAI模型為基礎的失控AI代理程式在7月攻擊AI新創Hugging Face，並試圖透過偽造紀錄掩蓋行動；另有一批OpenAI代理程式今年春季曾劫持一個德國網站，將其轉變成供其他AI代理程式交流的公告平台。這些事件進一步凸顯自主AI代理程式可能帶來的資安風險。
在美中科技競爭持續之際，AI也逐漸成為兩國領袖會談的重要議題。路透指出，美國擔心中國未來可能開發出具備高度網路攻擊能力的先進AI模型，同時華府也關注中國企業是否透過模型蒸餾等方式取得美國AI公司的技術能力。
對OpenAI而言，Altman出席國宴也讓他成為美中科技與AI議題交流中的重要企業代表。OpenAI目前並非上市公司，因此沒有可供標示的美股股票代碼。此次國宴預計將匯聚包括科技產業在內的重要人士，科技業者在AI發展、安全與美中科技競爭上的不同立場，也可能成為此次峰會期間受到外界關注的議題。
paras_en: OpenAI said on Wednesday (the 16th) that CEO Sam Altman will attend the state dinner that U.S. President Donald Trump is hosting for Chinese President Xi Jinping. Reuters noted the news was first disclosed by CNN, and Altman's participation draws attention to the involvement of senior U.S. tech executives during the U.S.-China leaders summit.

Trump is scheduled to meet Xi in Washington on September 24, when the two will hold a summit. The state dinner is a key diplomatic event in Trump’s itinerary for Xi’s U.S. visit, and Altman's confirmation signals that leaders of the American AI industry will take part in a high‑profile gathering focused on U.S.-China relations and technology issues.

In addition to Altman, Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang is also expected to attend the Trump‑Xi state dinner. Reuters, citing informed sources, reported Huang's planned participation; Huang has become a prominent figure in the global AI sector, and Nvidia is a major supplier of high‑end chips to AI developers.

The presence of senior tech executives comes against a backdrop of heightened U.S.-China discussions on the pace of AI development, safety risks and regulatory approaches. Reuters earlier reported that the two sides are preparing an AI safety dialogue, covering topics such as monitoring AI‑driven cyber attacks and sharing information through a joint U.S.-China AI lab to reduce related risks.

A Reuters report on September 4 said the AI safety dialogue was originally slated for mid‑September and is seen as a possible agenda item for the Trump‑Xi Washington summit on September 24. The U.S. hopes to discuss cooperation on monitoring AI‑related cyber attacks and has proposed that a bilateral AI lab oversee and share information to prevent such attacks.

AI safety has also become a hot issue in the United States. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei recently called for slowing the pace of frontier AI development to give safety measures more time to keep up, and OpenAI CEO Altman along with other tech leaders have publicly voiced support for the discussion. However, Trump disagrees with slowing AI progress, emphasizing that the U.S. must maintain a competitive edge over China.

Chinese officials have pushed back against U.S. calls to slow AI development. State media Global Times recently criticized Amodei’s slowdown proposal, saying it amounts to a restriction on China’s technological advancement. Beijing also urged cooperation on AI governance rather than confrontation or competition to address related challenges.

Both sides have faced concrete security incidents stemming from rapid AI advances. Reuters previously reported that nearly 700 rogue AI agents built on OpenAI models attacked the AI startup Hugging Face in July and tried to mask their actions with forged logs; another batch of OpenAI agents hijacked a German website in the spring, turning it into a bulletin board for other AI agents. These incidents highlight the cyber‑risk potential of autonomous AI agents.

As U.S.-China tech competition intensifies, AI is increasingly a central topic in leaders’ talks. Reuters noted that the United States worries China could develop advanced AI models capable of sophisticated cyber attacks, while Washington also monitors whether Chinese firms are acquiring U.S. AI technology through methods such as model distillation.

For OpenAI, Altman's attendance makes him a key corporate representative in the U.S.-China AI dialogue. OpenAI is not a publicly listed company and therefore has no U.S. stock ticker. The state dinner is expected to bring together many important figures, including those from the tech sector, and the differing positions of tech firms on AI development, safety and U.S.-China competition are likely to attract external attention during the summit.

items.title: 英特爾18A良率據報達80% Panther Lake量產進展成關鍵
items.title_en: Intel 18A Yield Reported at 80%; Panther Lake Production Progress Critical
paras: 英特爾(INTC-US)18A先進製程傳出重大進展，最新產業報告指出，搭載18A製程的Panther Lake處理器計算晶片，2026年第二季良率已達約80%，顯示這項被視為英特爾重建先進製造競爭力關鍵的製程，正逐步進入更成熟的量產階段。
根據外媒引述產業分析報告，Panther Lake的計算晶片尺寸約為8.004×14.288毫米，面積約114.304平方毫米。在這樣的晶片尺寸下，18A製程良率若能維持在約80%，意味著晶圓製造過程中的缺陷控制及晶片電性表現均已達到相對穩定的水準。
需要注意的是，80%並非英特爾官方公布的良率數字，而是產業分析與市場研究估算。近期市場報告對18A良率的估計有所不同，TrendForce今年7月曾指出，18A良率最高可能已提升至85%，較前一季約65%明顯改善；最新市場消息則將目前水準估計在約80%。
良率是先進製程能否實現大規模量產的關鍵指標之一。晶圓經過製程完成後，同一片晶圓上可以切割出大量裸晶，但其中部分晶片可能因製程缺陷或電性未達規格而無法使用，因此良率越高，代表每片晶圓能夠產出的合格晶片比例越高，也有助於降低單顆晶片製造成本。
此次受到市場關注的Panther Lake，是英特爾首款採用自家18A製程打造的產品。英特爾先前公布資訊顯示，Panther Lake是公司首款採用18A製程的產品，並定位為新一代AI PC平台。
18A是英特爾重新奪回先進製程競爭力的重要節點。相較過去製程延誤與良率問題，18A能否順利進入高產量製造，將直接影響英特爾產品路線及其代工業務的市場信心。
從製程指標來看，最新報告估計18A目前缺陷密度D0約為0.1至0.2，代表每平方公分面積中因製程缺陷造成失效的程度已經降至相對低的區間。隨著18A持續改善，加上Panther Lake進入量產並提高產能利用率，市場認為其缺陷密度可能進一步靠近0.1的下限。
Panther Lake計算晶片本身面積約114平方毫米，屬於相對有限的晶片尺寸，因此在缺陷密度下降後，單顆晶片達到可用規格的機率也會同步提高。市場報告認為，目前約80%的良率反映的不只是單純缺陷數量下降，也包括晶片各項電性及功能參數達標的比例有所改善。
這項變化對英特爾尤其重要，因為過去18A量產爬坡過程的一大挑戰並不只是晶圓上有多少物理缺陷，而是完成製造後，晶片能否同時符合性能、功耗及其他電性規格，也就是所謂參數良率。
產業分析報告指出，2026年第二季Panther Lake對應的18A製程良率約為80%，相較先前市場對18A成熟度的疑慮已出現明顯改善。另一方面，大型伺服器中央處理器專案CWF的良率仍明顯低於Panther Lake，目前最高約50%，但相較2026年6月約20%的水準，也顯示爬坡速度正在加快。
這意味著不同產品的18A製程成熟度仍存在差異。Panther Lake計算晶片面積較小、產品已進入量產階段，因此良率改善速度較快；大型伺服器CPU則因晶片規模及設計複雜度更高，製造難度也相對增加。
市場下一個關注焦點將落在Nova Lake。據產業報告，英特爾下一代Nova Lake處理器將採取更積極的雙來源製造策略，其中約80%至90%的計算晶片預計由英特爾自有工廠生產，其餘則交由台積電(TSM-US)等外部晶圓代工夥伴製造。
這種安排具有雙重意義。一方面，英特爾可以利用自家18A製程逐步擴大先進製程產品的內部製造比例；另一方面，透過台積電等外部供應商保留第二來源，可以降低單一製程或單一製造基地發生問題時對產品供應造成的衝擊。
Nova Lake也將成為市場觀察英特爾18A能否從單一產品量產，進一步擴大至更大規模產品組合的重要指標。如果18A能在Panther Lake上維持較高良率，並進一步支撐Nova Lake等後續產品，將有助英特爾提高自有先進製程的產能利用率。
此外，英特爾下一代14A製程的產能規劃也受到關注。市場預估，英特爾14A在2027年月產能可能達到約6000片晶圓，2028年進一步提高至約2.4萬片晶圓，顯示英特爾仍計畫持續擴充自有先進製程產能。
14A是英特爾在18A之後的重要製程節點。若18A能成功完成量產爬坡，不僅將影響Panther Lake及後續產品，也將成為英特爾推進14A製程開發、設備部署及客戶導入的重要基礎。
英特爾近年試圖重新建立製造優勢，並將自有晶圓代工業務視為長期策略核心。18A的進展因此不只是單一CPU產品的製造問題，也關係到英特爾能否同時扮演晶片設計商及先進晶圓代工業者。
在競爭環境方面，台積電目前仍是全球先進製程晶圓代工市場的重要業者。英特爾若要提高自有製程的外部客戶採用率，除了必須證明18A具備競爭力，也需要在良率、成本、產能、交貨穩定性及封裝能力等方面建立完整的製造生態系。
因此，單純的80%良率數字仍不足以代表18A已全面達到成熟製程的程度。對晶圓代工業務而言，客戶願意將大規模產品交給該製程生產，並且在長時間量產過程中維持穩定良率，才是衡量製程競爭力的重要標準。
不過，從目前市場揭露的數據來看，18A確實已較早期量產爬坡階段出現明顯改善。尤其Panther Lake良率若能維持約80%，同時CWF等大型產品的良率持續從6月約20%向50%區間提升，將代表英特爾正在逐步解決18A由試產走向大規模量產所面臨的製造挑戰。
對英特爾而言，接下來的關鍵不只是將18A良率提升至更高水準，而是能否在提高產量的同時維持良率，並將這項製程能力延伸至伺服器CPU及未來更多產品。若能完成這一轉換，18A將有機會從單一產品節點，成為英特爾重建自有先進製造能力及推動代工業務的核心基礎。
目前市場仍需持續觀察英特爾官方財報及後續法說會是否提供18A良率、晶圓產量及客戶導入等更明確數據。由於上述80%及相關產能數字主要來自產業研究與外部估算，因此在英特爾正式揭露前，仍應視為市場估計，而非公司確認的正式數據。
paras_en: Intel (INTC-US) 18A advanced process is reported to have made significant progress, with the latest industry report indicating that the Panther Lake processor compute chip using the 18A process achieved a yield of about 80% in Q2 2026, showing that this process, seen as key to Intel’s rebuilding of advanced manufacturing competitiveness, is gradually moving into a more mature volume‑production stage.

According to foreign media citing an industry analysis report, the Panther Lake compute chip measures roughly 8.004 × 14.288 mm, with an area of about 114.304 mm². At this chip size, maintaining an 18A yield of around 80% implies that defect control and electrical performance on the wafer have reached a relatively stable level.

It should be noted that the 80% figure is not an official Intel‑released yield number but an estimate from industry analysis and market research. Recent market reports have varied in their 18A yield estimates; TrendForce in July said the 18A yield may have risen to as high as 85%, a marked improvement from roughly 65% the previous quarter, while the latest market news places the current level at about 80%.

Yield is one of the key indicators of whether an advanced process can achieve large‑scale volume production. After wafer processing, many die can be cut from a single wafer, but some may be unusable due to process defects or failing electrical specs, so a higher yield means a larger proportion of good dies per wafer and helps lower the cost per chip.

The Panther Lake that is attracting market attention is Intel’s first product built on its own 18A process. Intel previously announced that Panther Lake is the company’s first 18A‑based product and is positioned as a next‑generation AI PC platform.

The 18A node is a crucial milestone for Intel to regain competitiveness in advanced processes. Compared with past delays and yield issues, whether 18A can smoothly enter high‑volume manufacturing will directly affect Intel’s product roadmap and the market confidence in its foundry business.

From a process metric standpoint, the latest report estimates the current defect density (D0) for 18A at about 0.1‑0.2, meaning the failure rate due to process defects per square centimeter has dropped into a relatively low range. As 18A continues to improve and Panther Lake ramps up production and capacity utilization, the market believes defect density could move closer to the lower bound of 0.1.

Panther Lake’s compute chip area is about 114 mm², which is relatively small, so as defect density falls, the probability that each die meets usable specifications also rises. The market report says the roughly 80% yield reflects not only fewer defects but also improvements in the proportion of chips meeting electrical and functional parameters.

This shift is especially important for Intel because a major challenge in the 18A volume‑ramp has been not just the number of physical defects on the wafer but whether the finished chips meet performance, power and other electrical specs – the so‑called parameter yield.

Industry analysis reports indicate that Panther Lake’s 18A yield was about 80% in Q2 2026, showing a clear improvement over earlier market concerns about 18A maturity. By contrast, the large‑server CPU project CWF still has a markedly lower yield, currently around 50% at best, though it has risen from roughly 20% in June 2026, indicating an accelerating ramp.

This means that 18A maturity varies across products. Panther Lake’s smaller die and its entry into volume production have allowed its yield to improve faster, whereas large server CPUs face higher difficulty due to larger die size and more complex designs.

The next market focus will shift to Nova Lake. According to industry reports, Intel’s next‑generation Nova Lake processor will adopt a more aggressive dual‑source manufacturing strategy, with about 80‑90% of its compute chips expected to be produced in Intel’s own fabs and the remainder by external partners such as TSMC (TSM‑US).

This arrangement has a dual significance. On one hand, Intel can use its own 18A process to gradually increase the internal manufacturing share of advanced‑process products; on the other hand, retaining a second source with external suppliers like TSMC reduces supply risk if a single process or fab encounters problems.

Nova Lake will also become a key indicator for the market to see whether Intel’s 18A can expand from a single product’s volume production to a broader product portfolio. If 18A maintains high yields on Panther Lake and supports follow‑on products like Nova Lake, Intel can improve utilization of its own advanced‑process capacity.

In addition, Intel’s next‑generation 14A process capacity plans are drawing attention. The market estimates Intel’s 14A monthly capacity could reach about 6,000 wafers in 2027 and rise to roughly 24,000 wafers in 2028, showing Intel’s intent to continue expanding its own advanced‑process output.

The 14A node is an important step after 18A for Intel. If 18A successfully completes its volume‑ramp, it will not only affect Panther Lake and subsequent products but also form a crucial foundation for advancing 14A development, equipment deployment and customer adoption.

Intel has been trying to re‑establish manufacturing advantage in recent years and treats its own wafer‑foundry business as a core long‑term strategy. Therefore, progress on 18A is not just a single CPU manufacturing issue but also tied to Intel’s ability to act as both a chip designer and an advanced‑process foundry provider.

In the competitive landscape, TSMC remains a major player in the global advanced‑process foundry market. For Intel to increase external customer adoption of its own process, it must not only prove 18A’s competitiveness but also build a complete manufacturing ecosystem covering yield, cost, capacity, delivery stability and packaging capabilities.

Thus, a simple 80% yield figure is insufficient to claim that 18A has fully reached mature‑process status. For the foundry business, customers need confidence to ship large‑scale products on the process and maintain stable yields over long‑term volume production, which is the true measure of process competitiveness.

Nevertheless, disclosed market data shows that 18A has already made noticeable improvements over its early‑ramp stage. Especially if Panther Lake can sustain about an 80% yield while large products like CWF lift their yields from roughly 20% in June to the 50% range, it indicates Intel is gradually overcoming the manufacturing challenges of moving 18A from pilot to large‑scale production.

For Intel, the next key is not only to push 18A yield higher but also to maintain yield while scaling output and extend this capability to server CPUs and future products. Achieving this transition would allow 18A to evolve from a single‑product node into the core foundation for Intel’s rebuilding of its own advanced manufacturing capability and its foundry business.

The market still needs to watch Intel’s official earnings releases and subsequent briefings for more concrete data on 18A yield, wafer output and customer adoption. Since the 80% figure and related capacity numbers stem mainly from industry research and external estimates, they should be treated as market speculation until Intel formally discloses them.

items.title: AI資料中心電力需求爆發 亞馬遜砸最高80億美元買發電機 Generac盤後飆逾40%
items.title_en: AI Data Center Power Demand Booms; Amazon Commits Up to $8 Billion for Generac Generators, Shares Surge Over 40% After Hours
paras: 亞馬遜(AMZN-US)周三(16日)宣布與發電設備製造商Generac Holdings(GNRC-US)簽署長期供應協議, 將向Generac採購備用發電機, 以支援旗下資料中心的電力需求。這項合作的潛在付款總額最高可達80億美元, 同時亞馬遜也取得購買Generac股票的認股權證, 消息公布後推升Generac股價, 盤後一度大漲超過40%。
根據Generac提交的監管文件, 亞馬遜旗下Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings取得認股權證, 最多可購買Generac 1,693,745股普通股, 執行價格為每股200.9266美元, 若全部行使, 認購金額約3.4億美元。
其中約307,954股認股權證股份立即歸屬, 其餘股份則將依亞馬遜及其關係企業未來向Generac支付的備用發電機款項, 按照累計付款金額分批歸屬。這意味著亞馬遜最終能夠取得多少Generac股份, 將與未來實際採購規模直接相關。
雙方此次簽署的長期供應協議, 初始訂單涉及2027年及2028年交付的備用發電機, 金額合計約24億美元。若後續採購持續增加, 整體供應協議的付款總額最高可達80億美元。
Generac股價周三正常交易收在175.11美元, 當日僅上漲0.05%, 但在雙方公布合作消息後, 盤後股價一度飆升超過40%, 盤後交易一度突破240美元, 隨後漲幅有所收斂。
亞馬遜此次採購與AI資料中心擴張有直接關聯。隨著生成式AI快速發展, 雲端運算及資料中心對電力需求持續增加, 大型科技公司除了需要取得穩定的電網供電, 也必須配置大型備用發電設備, 以避免電力中斷影響高價值運算設備及AI服務運作。
Generac是全球主要備用發電機製造商之一, 產品涵蓋住宅、商業及工業市場。近年AI資料中心快速擴張, 已使資料中心成為公司重要的成長市場。Generac也持續增加生產能力, 以因應大型資料中心客戶對兆瓦級備用發電設備的需求。
Generac此前曾表示, 資料中心業務的長期成長潛力強勁, 並預估到2028年資料中心相關銷售額可達10億美元。公司近年也投入約2.5億美元擴充產能, 並增加約1,000名員工, 以應付資料中
paras_en: Amazon (AMZN-US) announced on Wednesday (the 16th) that it has signed a long‑term supply agreement with generator maker Generac Holdings (GNRC-US) to purchase backup generators to support the power needs of its data centers. The potential total payment under the deal could reach as much as $8 billion, and Amazon also received warrants to buy Generac stock, which lifted Generac’s share price, spiking more than 40% in after‑hours trading.

According to regulatory filings submitted by Generac, Amazon’s subsidiary Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings obtained warrants to purchase up to 1,693,745 shares of Generac common stock at an exercise price of $200.9266 per share, which would amount to roughly $340 million if fully exercised.

About 307,954 of the warrant shares vest immediately, while the remaining shares will vest in tranches tied to the amount Amazon and its affiliates subsequently pay Generac for backup generators, based on cumulative payments. This means the ultimate number of Generac shares Amazon can acquire will be directly linked to the actual scale of future purchases.

The long‑term supply agreement’s initial orders cover backup generators to be delivered in 2027 and 2028, with a total value of about $2.4 billion. If subsequent purchases continue to grow, the overall contract’s payment ceiling could rise to as much as $8 billion.

Generac’s stock closed on Wednesday’s regular session at $175.11, up only 0.05% on the day, but after the partnership was announced the after‑hours price surged more than 40%, briefly breaking $240 before easing back.

Amazon’s procurement is directly tied to its expansion of AI data centers. As generative AI rapidly advances, cloud computing and data centers are seeing ever‑increasing power demand. Large tech firms not only need reliable grid power but also must equip massive backup generators to avoid outages that could disrupt high‑value computing equipment and AI services.

Generac is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of backup generators, serving residential, commercial and industrial markets. The rapid growth of AI data centers has made the data‑center segment a key growth market for the company, prompting Generac to expand production capacity to meet megawatt‑scale backup power needs of large‑scale data‑center customers.

Generac has previously said that the long‑term growth potential of its data‑center business is strong, projecting data‑center‑related sales to reach $1 billion by 2028. The company has invested roughly $250 million in recent years to expand capacity and added about 1,000 employees to handle the growing data‑center demand.

items.title: 從AI到國防 英加領袖會談聚焦科技合作與網路安全
items.title_en: From AI to Defense: UK-Canada Leaders Discuss Tech Cooperation and Cybersecurity
paras: 英國首相Andy Burnham與加拿大總理Mark Carney周三(16日)在英格蘭北部會面, 雙方討論人工智慧(AI)帶來的機會與挑戰, 並同意政府與科技產業應加強合作, 處理共同面臨的問題及維護網路安全。英國首相府表示, AI及線上安全是雙方會談的重要議題之一。
兩人在英格蘭北部會面期間, 除了討論AI發展及網路安全, 也談及國防工業合作。Carney辦公室表示, 雙方討論透過「全球戰鬥航空計畫」(Global Combat Air Programme, GCAP)擴大國防工業合作。加拿大已於2026年7月加入該先進戰機計畫的觀察員行列。
此次會面是在英加雙方持續強化國防、科技及安全合作的背景下進行。加拿大同日也正式申請加入由英國主導的聯合遠征軍(Joint Expeditionary Force, JEF), 該組織由10個北約成員國組成, 包括丹麥、愛沙尼亞、芬蘭、冰島、拉脫維亞、立陶宛、荷蘭、挪威、瑞典及英國。加拿大政府表示, 加入申請是擴大與歐洲盟友防務合作的一環。
AI議題則反映英國政府目前對科技發展與安全風險的政策關注。Burnham此前曾表示, 對先進AI風險的討論是正面的發展, 但政策決定應建立在證據而非推測之上。英國政府近期也持續強化線上安全規範, 尤其針對兒童使用數位服務及AI帶來的新風險。
英國政府9月9日宣布, 將準備新的立法, 要求科技公司加強裝置層級的兒童安全防護, 使未滿18歲者無法在裝置上拍攝、觀看或傳送裸露影像。政府表示, 這項措施是在6月要求大型科技公司改善兒童安全措施後推出, 目前雖已與企業進行協商並取得部分進展, 但政府認為現有承諾仍未達到預期程度。
英國政府表示, 新措施將要求相關保護功能預設開啟, 並由科技公司負責證明使用者已達到適用年齡, 而不是要求兒童自行避免接觸有害內容。政府並稱, 將透過立法建立裝置層級防護, 以降低兒童遭受網路誘騙、性剝削及虐待的風險。
英國7月公布的「在網路世界成長」政策回應也提出更多兒童線上安全措施。政府表示, 這項全國諮詢共收到超過11.6萬名家長、兒童、教師、醫療人員、慈善團體及其他人士的意見。政策內容包括針對16歲及17歲青少年的預設保護措施, 包括午夜至上午6時限制使用、夜間關閉推播通知, 以及預設關閉自動播放與個人化推薦內容。
該政策也將進一步處理AI聊天機器人等新興風險, 同時採取措施降低使用者規避線上安全限制的可能性。英國政府並表示, 將與Ofcom合作準備相關執法工作, 同時提供家長及兒童更多數位素養與線上安全支援。
在企業方面, 英國政府此前已與蘋果(AAPL-US)及Alphabet旗下Google(GOOGL-US)協商兒童裝置安全措施。政府9月公布的說明指出, 兩家公司已取得一定進展, 但政府認為相關措施仍不足以達到其政策目標, 因此準備透過立法進一步要求科技產業落實裝置層級保護。
此次英加領袖會談也正值全球AI治理討論升溫之際。近期AI產業內部對如何處理先進AI安全風險出現不同看法, 部分業者主張需要更強的外部監督與安全措施, 另一些科技業領袖則認為企業自身已有足夠誘因確保AI產品安全。路透報導指出, 目前爭論的核心之一是AI安全措施應由企業自行管理, 還是需要政府及獨立機構進一步介入。
英國近期也積極參與AI安全討論。英國國王查爾斯日前安排與主要AI企業領袖會面, 討論是否需要共同原則來引導AI發展, 參與者包括輝達(NVDA-US)、Google DeepMind、OpenAI及Anthropic等企業或機構。相關討論聚焦如何在發展AI技術的同時, 降低可能對社會及人類造成的風險。
對英國與加拿大而言, AI合作並非單純的科技議題, 也與國防、網路安全及新興技術合作相互交織。兩國此次討論GCAP及其他國防合作計畫, 顯示AI、無人機、衛星通訊、量子科技及其他先進技術, 正逐漸成為雙邊安全合作的一部分。
Burnham與Carney此次會談未公布具體的AI合作計畫或新的監管措施, 英國首相府僅表示, 雙方同意政府與科技產業需要共同處理AI帶來的共享問題, 並維護線上安全。隨著英國進一步推動兒童線上安全立法, 以及全球持續討論AI治理框架, 政府與科技企業之間的責任分工仍將是後續政策討論的重點。
paras_en: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney met on Wednesday (the 16th) in northern England, discussing the opportunities and challenges posed by artificial intelligence (AI) and agreeing that governments and the tech industry should deepen cooperation to address shared issues and safeguard cyber security. The UK Prime Minister’s Office said AI and online safety were key topics of the talks.

During their meeting in northern England, the leaders also talked about defence industry collaboration. Carney’s office said they discussed expanding defence cooperation through the Global Combat Air Programme (GCAP). Canada joined the programme’s observer list in July 2026.

The meeting took place against a backdrop of ongoing UK‑Canada efforts to strengthen defence, technology and security cooperation. On the same day Canada formally applied to join the UK‑led Joint Expeditionary Force (JEF), a group of ten NATO members – Denmark, Estonia, Finland, Iceland, Latvia, Lithuania, the Netherlands, Norway, Sweden and the United Kingdom. The Canadian government said the application was part of expanding defence ties with European allies.

The AI discussion reflects the UK government’s current policy focus on technology development and security risks. Burnham has previously said that debate over advanced AI risks is a positive development, but policy decisions should be based on evidence rather than speculation. The UK has recently been tightening online safety rules, especially concerning children’s use of digital services and new risks from AI.

On September 9 the UK government announced it will prepare new legislation requiring tech firms to strengthen device‑level child‑safety protections so that anyone under 18 cannot capture, view or transmit nude images on a device. The government said the measure follows a June request for large tech companies to improve child‑safety measures; although negotiations have yielded some progress, the government believes existing commitments fall short of expectations.

The new rules will require the relevant protective functions to be enabled by default, with tech firms responsible for proving users meet the applicable age threshold, rather than placing the burden on children to avoid harmful content. The government said it will use legislation to create device‑level safeguards to reduce children’s risk of online grooming, sexual exploitation and abuse.

The UK’s July “Growing Up Online” policy response also introduced additional child‑online‑safety measures. The nationwide consultation received over 116,000 responses from parents, children, teachers, health professionals, charities and others. The policy includes default protections for 16‑ and 17‑year‑olds such as limiting use from midnight to 6 a.m., disabling night‑time push notifications, and turning off autoplay and personalized recommendation features by default.

The policy will also address emerging risks from AI chatbots and take steps to reduce users’ ability to circumvent online‑safety limits. The government said it will work with Ofcom to prepare related enforcement work while providing parents and children with more digital‑literacy and online‑safety support.

On the corporate side, the UK government has previously negotiated child‑device safety measures with Apple (AAPL‑US) and Google (GOOGL‑US). A September briefing noted that both companies have made some progress, but the government believes the measures remain insufficient to meet policy goals, prompting plans to use legislation to further require industry‑wide device‑level protection.

The UK‑Canada leaders’ talks come as global debate over AI governance heats up. Recently, divergent views have emerged within the AI industry on how to handle advanced AI safety risks, with some actors calling for stronger external oversight and safeguards, while other tech leaders argue firms already have enough incentive to ensure AI product safety. Reuters reported that a core point of contention is whether AI safety measures should be managed by companies themselves or require further government and independent‑agency intervention.

The UK has also been actively participating in AI safety discussions. King Charles recently arranged a meeting with senior AI company leaders to discuss whether common principles are needed to guide AI development. Participants included Nvidia (NVDA‑US), Google DeepMind, OpenAI and Anthropic, among others. The talks focused on how to reduce potential societal and human risks while advancing AI technology.

For both the UK and Canada, AI cooperation is not just a pure technology issue; it intertwines with defence, cyber security and emerging‑technology collaboration. Their discussion of GCAP and other defence projects shows that AI, drones, satellite communications, quantum tech and other advanced technologies are increasingly becoming part of bilateral security cooperation.

Burnham and Carney did not announce any specific AI cooperation projects or new regulatory measures. The Prime Minister’s Office said the two sides agreed that governments and the tech sector need to work together on shared AI challenges and maintain online safety. As the UK pushes forward with child‑online‑safety legislation and global AI‑governance debates continue, the division of responsibilities between governments and tech firms will remain a focal point of future policy discussions.

items.title: Fed升息1碼惹怒川普 喊話利率應降至1%以下
items.title_en: Fed Rate Hike Angers Trump, Calls for Rates Below 1%
paras: 聯準會 (Fed) 週三 (16 日) 宣布2023年以來首次升息後，美國總統川普隨即要求央行迅速將利率降至1%或更低。白宮亦批評這項決定「相當令人遺憾」，認為升息缺乏充分的經濟依據，但未直接批評Fed主席華許。
Fed稍早以12比0一致決議升息1碼，將聯邦資金利率目標區間調高至3.75%至4%。聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 在聲明中表示，通膨仍處於高檔；最新利率預測顯示，多數官員認為今年可能再次升息。
川普隨後在Truth Social發文表示，美國利率「應該降至1%或更低」，理由是美國擁有全球最佳信用。他並以全大寫文字要求：「為美國降低利率，而且要快！」
川普聲稱，美國正在支撐全球多數國家，這種情況不能繼續下去。他並以美國吸引大量新增投資，以及對許多國家存在貿易逆差為由，主張美國應適用更低利率。
白宮發言人德賽 (Kush Desai) 接受福斯新聞訪問時表示，川普已清楚說明希望利率朝哪個方向移動，而Fed當天決定升息，從政府立場來看「相當令人遺憾」，也缺乏特別有力的經濟依據。
德賽指出，目前並非拜登政府時期，川普與共和黨沒有投入數兆美元的新冠疫情刺激支出，因此不存在需要透過提高利率加以抑制的失控總需求。
儘管白宮反對這次升息，德賽仍表示，川普相信Fed應保持獨立，但這不影響總統在認為政策出現問題時公開表達意見的權利。
川普近期已重新加大對Fed的施壓力道。不到兩週前，他曾警告，如果Fed不降息，可能停止與對美國享有貿易順差的國家進行貿易，涉及美國多數主要貿易夥伴及其他數十個國家。
不過，川普與白宮官員目前仍未直接抨擊由川普任命的華許。華許接替鮑爾出任Fed主席後，川普對央行的公開施壓一度減弱，如今情況可能隨著Fed轉向升息而改變，華許也將面臨更大的白宮政治壓力。
paras_en: The Federal Reserve announced on Wednesday the 16th that it had raised rates for the first time since 2023, prompting President Trump to immediately demand that the central bank swiftly cut rates to 1% or lower. The White House also criticized the decision as "quite regrettable," saying the hike lacked sufficient economic justification, though it did not directly criticize Fed Chair Jerome Powell.

Earlier that day, the Fed voted unanimously 12‑0 to raise rates by one quarter point, moving the federal funds target range to 3.75%‑4%. In its statement, the Federal Open Market Committee said inflation remains high; the latest rate forecasts show most officials think another hike could be possible this year.

Trump then posted on Truth Social that U.S. rates "should be cut to 1% or lower," arguing that the United States has the best credit in the world. He wrote in all‑caps: "Lower rates for America, and do it fast!"

Trump claimed the United States is supporting most of the world’s economies and that this situation cannot continue. Citing the influx of new investment into the U.S. and large trade deficits with many countries, he argued that America should enjoy lower rates.

White House spokesperson Kush Desai told Fox News that Trump has made clear the direction he wants rates to move, and that the Fed’s decision to raise rates that day was "quite regrettable" from the government’s perspective and lacked particularly strong economic justification.

Desai noted that this is not the Biden administration era; Trump and the Republican Party have not poured trillions of dollars into COVID‑19 stimulus, so there is no runaway aggregate demand that needs to be curbed by higher rates.

Although the White House opposes the hike, Desai said Trump believes the Fed should remain independent, and that does not prevent the president from publicly voicing his opinion when he thinks policy is wrong.

Trump has recently stepped up pressure on the Fed again. Less than two weeks ago he warned that if the Fed does not cut rates, he could halt trade with countries that run trade surpluses with the United States, affecting most of America’s major trading partners and dozens of other nations.

However, neither Trump nor White House officials have directly attacked Powell, who was appointed by Trump. After Powell succeeded Jerome Powell as Fed chair, Trump’s public pressure on the central bank had eased, but the situation may change as the Fed moves toward hikes, and Powell could face greater political pressure from the White House.

items.title: 英特爾上漲4% 投資人盼記憶體晶片成轉型下一步
items.title_en: Intel Rises 4% as Investors Hope Memory Chips Are the Next Step in Its Transformation
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，英特爾(Intel)(INTC-US)的起源可追溯到記憶體晶片業務，但由於經濟效益不佳，公司後來退出了這項業務。不過，隨著記憶體晶片市場再次熱絡，投資人期待英特爾能重新參與其中。
英特爾股價周三上漲4%。
據《路透社》昨夜消息，英特爾正在與SK海力士(SK Hynix)(SKHY-US)進行討論。這家南韓晶片製造商正考慮於美國生產記憶體晶片。
報導指出，SK海力士的選項包括租用英特爾位於俄亥俄州一座規劃中的廠房部分設施，或與英特爾及其他公司成立合資企業。
消息指出，目前雙方的討論仍處於「探索階段」，最終不一定會形成商業合作關係。此外，南韓政府可能反對這類合作。
英特爾發言人表示，「作為公司政策，我們不會針對媒體對未來商業安排的猜測發表評論。不過，英特爾致力於俄亥俄州，我們也持續投資，以加快該基地的建設準備工作。」
英特爾目前並不銷售記憶體晶片，但公司確實提供晶片製造產能。大多數美國晶片公司都將半導體製造外包給台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)。但英特爾同時具備自行製造晶片的能力，也有能力為其晶圓代工部門爭取具規模的業務，該部門負責替其他業界公司製造晶片。
英特爾正處於一場復興之中，公司已獲得美國政府與輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)的投資，同時人工智慧也正重新點燃其業務成長。
隨著新型AI工作負載需要更多CPU，英特爾用於伺服器的CPU已成為市場熱門商品。
這代表AI產業的敘事出現轉變。早期的AI發展敘事中，相較於輝達生產的GPU等產品，CPU的重要性較低。
記憶體晶片則是AI硬體市場中另一個熱門領域。目前只有少數幾家公司能夠生產記憶體晶片，且其生產速度仍不足以滿足從事資料密集型工作負載的AI公司強勁需求。
即使企業決定擴大產能，也需要時間才能真正增加製造能力。而目前主要業者確實都有提升產能的計畫，但同時對擴產保持審慎態度。
paras_en: MarketWatch reports that Intel’s origins trace back to the memory‑chip business, but poor economics led the company to exit that segment. Now, with the memory market heating up again, investors are hoping Intel will re‑enter it.
Intel’s stock jumped 4% on Wednesday.
According to Reuters last night, Intel is in talks with SK Hynix. The South Korean chipmaker is considering producing memory chips in the United States.
The report says SK Hynix’s options include leasing part of Intel’s planned Ohio fab or forming a joint venture with Intel and other partners.
Sources say the discussions are still in an “exploratory” phase and may not result in a commercial deal, and the South Korean government could oppose such cooperation.

An Intel spokesperson said, “As company policy we do not comment on media speculation about future business arrangements. However, Intel is committed to Ohio and continues to invest to accelerate the site’s build‑out preparation.”

Intel does not currently sell memory chips, but it does offer chip‑manufacturing capacity. Most U.S. chip firms outsource semiconductor production to TSMC, yet Intel both manufactures its own chips and can secure sizable business for its foundry services that produce chips for other companies.
Intel is in the midst of a revival, having secured investment from the U.S. government and Nvidia, while artificial intelligence is reigniting its growth prospects.
As new AI workloads demand more CPUs, Intel’s server CPUs have become hot commodities in the market.
This signals a shift in the AI narrative. In early AI stories, CPUs were seen as less important compared to Nvidia’s GPUs and similar products.

Memory chips are another hot segment of the AI hardware market. Only a handful of firms can produce them, and current production speeds fall short of the strong demand from data‑intensive AI workloads.

Even when companies decide to expand capacity, it takes time to truly increase manufacturing output. While the major players do have plans to boost capacity, they remain cautious about rapid expansion.

items.title: 不再一條龍！三星客製化HBM擬採雙軌並行：自廠或台積電製造基礎裸片任客戶挑
items.title_en: No More One‑Stop Shop! Samsung’s Custom HBM to Use Dual‑Track Parallel Strategy: Customers Can Choose In‑House or TSMC‑Made Base Dies
paras: 最新消息傳出，三星在客製化HBM將採雙軌策略，依客戶需求提供自廠或台積電基礎裸片(Base Die)，若選台積電，由記憶體業務負責設計，已有客戶採「台積電Base Bie＋三星DRAM」方案，顯示其不再堅持一體化供貨，改以提高供應鏈彈性接單。
高頻寬記憶體(HBM)架構正出現關鍵轉折，過往基礎裸片(Base Die)多用DRAM製程，自HBM4起逐步改由邏輯代工生產，以解決AI高速運算下的散熱、訊號延遲與能效問題，客製化HBM更可把記憶體控制器等功能下移到底層，使得「記憶體堆疊」更接近運算系統。
三星HBM4以自家代工生產基礎裸片，SK海力士、美光則與台積電合作，業界估邏輯base die成本高於傳統DRAM方案，三星因自有代工在內部生產與產能調配具潛在彈性，通用HBM4量產已佔先機。
另有傳聞指出，SK海力士自HBM4E起評估把部分基礎裸片交英特爾代工，降低對台積電單一依賴、兼顧成本與供應穩定，但SK海力士對相關技術細節僅回應「難以確認」、部分報導不實。
分析人士指出，隨著AI加速器客制化程度升高，base die已成HBM新戰場，擁代工、擁多供應商與能整合控制器者，將在主權、雲端客戶爭單中更具談判空間。
paras_en: The latest news reports that Samsung will adopt a dual‑track strategy for custom HBM, offering customers either in‑house or TSMC‑fabricated base dies (Base Die) according to their needs. If TSMC is chosen, the memory business unit handles the design, and some customers have already taken the “TSMC Base Die + Samsung DRAM” approach, showing that Samsung is no longer insisting on a fully integrated supply and is instead increasing supply‑chain flexibility to win orders.

High‑bandwidth memory (HBM) architecture is reaching a critical turning point. Historically, base dies were mostly produced with DRAM processes, but starting with HBM4 they are gradually being made by logic foundries to address heat, signal‑delay and energy‑efficiency challenges of AI‑heavy workloads. Custom HBM can also push functions such as the memory controller down to the lower layers, making the “memory stack” sit even closer to the compute system.

Samsung’s HBM4 uses its own fabs to produce the base die, while SK Hynix and Micron partner with TSMC. Industry estimates that logic‑based base dies cost more than traditional DRAM solutions, but Samsung’s internal manufacturing gives it potential flexibility in production and capacity allocation, giving it an early lead in mass‑producing generic HBM4.

There are also rumors that SK Hynix, starting with HBM4E, is evaluating handing over part of its base‑die production to Intel’s foundry to reduce reliance on a single TSMC supplier and balance cost and supply stability. SK Hynix, however, only said the details are “hard to confirm,” and some reports are inaccurate.

Analysts note that as AI accelerators become more customized, the base die has become the new battleground for HBM. Companies that own a fab, have multiple suppliers and can integrate the controller will have greater negotiating power when competing for sovereign and cloud customers.

items.title: Fed 3年來首度升息後 市場押注再升息 加元重貶至6週低點
items.title_en: After the Fed's First Rate Hike in Three Years, Markets Bet on Further Hikes as the Canadian Dollar Slumps to a Six‑Week Low
paras: 加拿大元周三(16日)走弱，兌美元跌至6週低點，主要受到美國聯準會(Fed)宣布3年來首度升息，以及市場進一步押注未來數月仍可能持續升息的影響。加元盤中一度觸及1美元兌1.3994加元，為8月7日以來最低，尾盤報1.3990加元，單日下跌0.5%，相當於1加元兌71.48美分。
聯準會周三將基準利率上調25個基點至3.75%-4.00%，並釋放未來數月可能進一步提高借貸成本的訊號，目標是讓通膨更及時回到2%的政策目標。聯準會最新聲明指出，美國經濟活動仍以穩健速度擴張，生產力成長強勁、資本投資保持韌性，但通膨仍處於偏高水準，因此本次升息有助於加快通膨回落至2%。
市場對後續升息的預期同步升溫，美元因此走強，進一步壓抑加元表現。Corpay(CPAY-US)首席市場策略師Karl Schamotta表示，美元兌主要貨幣持續走高，美國公債殖利率也在對貨幣政策敏感的期限段上升，投資人正逐步提高對聯準會12月再次升息的預期。
聯準會最新經濟預測也顯示，18名政策制定者中有16人預期今年底前至少還會升息1次，若按照多數官員預測，聯邦基金利率年底可能升至4.00%-4.25%區間，顯示聯準會在通膨仍偏高的情況下，並未排除持續緊縮的可能性。
加拿大方面，市場同樣開始評估加拿大央行後續升息可能性。互換市場數據顯示，加拿大央行未來幾個月也可能收緊貨幣政策。加拿大央行9月2日維持隔夜利率目標在2.25%，當時已指出通膨上行風險升高，尤其高油價持續時間越長，能源成本向其他商品與服務價格擴散的風險越大。
加拿大央行9月會議紀要顯示，決策官員認為通膨短期內可能維持在較高水準。央行9月2日公布的政策聲明則指出，加拿大第2季GDP年化成長率達3.3%，經濟活動普遍改善，消費、住宅市場、出口及企業投資均有所回升；7月失業率則降至6.4%。不過，央行同時表示，美國新關稅及加拿大反制措施仍使經濟前景存在高度不確定性。
能源價格走勢也對加元構成壓力。原油是加拿大主要出口商品之一，國際油價周三下跌，市場因沙烏地阿拉伯透過阿曼提供額外原油貨載的消息，降低對中東供應中斷規模的疑慮。美國原油期貨周三結算下跌3.2%，報每桶102.43美元。
油價下跌對加元尤其受到關注，因能源出口是加拿大經濟與貿易的重要組成部分。當原油價格回落時，加拿大出口收入及商品貨幣相關資金流可能受到影響，加上美元受到美國升息預期支撐，雙重因素使加元承受壓力。
加拿大國內經濟數據亦未提供加元太多支撐。加拿大8月房屋開工率折合年率為229,046戶，低於7月經修正後的229,360戶，也低於經濟學家預期的240,000戶，顯示住宅建設活動略有降溫。
加拿大公債殖利率則呈現曲線趨平走勢。2年期殖利率上升2個基點至3.376%，10年期殖利率則下滑1.1個基點至3.941%，延續周一觸及接近3年高點3.987%後的回落走勢。
在美加利差重新受到市場關注之際，美元走強也不只壓抑加元。聯準會升息後，美元指數周三上漲0.3%，報99.961，創近5週新高；歐元下跌0.3%至1.1502美元，英鎊下跌0.5%至1.34155美元，美元兌日元則上升0.3%至155.49日元。
加拿大央行目前的政策利率仍明顯低於聯準會，但若美國持續升息、加拿大央行維持利率不變，美加利率差可能進一步擴大，成為支撐美元兌加元匯率的重要因素。不過，加拿大央行9月政策聲明也指出，將持續評估經濟復甦的可持續性及通膨前景，並準備在必要時調整貨幣政策。
因此，近期加元走勢將同時受到聯準會後續利率路徑、加拿大央行政策方向、美元表現及原油價格影響。市場目前尤其關注聯準會是否在今年底前再度升息，以及加拿大通膨與經濟數據是否足以促使加拿大央行改變目前的政策立場。
paras_en: The Canadian dollar weakened on Wednesday, falling to a six‑week low against the U.S. dollar, mainly due to the Federal Reserve’s announcement of its first rate hike in three years and markets further betting that rate increases could continue in the coming months. The CAD briefly touched 1.3994 per U.S. dollar, the lowest since August 7, and closed at 1.3990, down 0.5% for the day, equivalent to 1 CAD = 71.48 US cents.

The Fed raised its benchmark rate by 25 basis points on Wednesday to a target range of 3.75%‑4.00% and signaled that borrowing costs could rise further in the months ahead, aiming to bring inflation back to the 2% policy goal more promptly. The Fed’s latest statement noted that U.S. economic activity is still expanding at a solid pace, productivity growth is strong, capital investment remains resilient, but inflation remains elevated, so this hike helps accelerate inflation’s return to 2%.

Market expectations for additional hikes warmed up in tandem, strengthening the dollar and further suppressing the Canadian dollar. Corpay (CPAY‑US) chief market strategist Karl Schamotta said the dollar’s rise against major currencies continues, U.S. Treasury yields are also climbing in policy‑sensitive maturities, and investors are gradually raising expectations for another Fed hike in December.

The Fed’s latest economic forecasts also show that 16 of 18 policymakers expect at least one more hike before the end of the year; based on the majority view, the federal funds rate could end the year in the 4.00%‑4.25% range, indicating the Fed has not ruled out continued tightening while inflation stays above target.

In Canada, the market likewise began assessing the possibility of further Bank of Canada hikes. Swap‑market data suggest the BoC may tighten policy over the next few months. The BoC kept its overnight rate target at 2.25% on September 2, noting heightened upside inflation risks, especially the longer high oil prices persist, the greater the risk that energy costs will spill over into other goods and services.

BoC September meeting minutes showed policymakers believe inflation could remain at a relatively high level in the short term. The policy statement released on September 2 said Canada’s Q2 GDP grew at an annualized 3.3%, economic activity broadly improved, and consumption, housing, exports and business investment all rebounded; July unemployment fell to 6.4%. However, the bank also said new U.S. tariffs and Canadian counter‑measures keep the economic outlook highly uncertain.

Energy‑price trends also put pressure on the CAD. Crude oil is one of Canada’s main export commodities, and international oil prices fell on Wednesday as the market eased concerns over Middle‑East supply disruptions after Saudi Arabia offered additional cargoes via Oman. U.S. crude futures settled down 3.2% at $102.43 a barrel.

The oil‑price drop is especially watched for the CAD because energy exports are a key component of Canada’s economy and trade. When oil prices retreat, Canadian export revenues and commodity‑currency flows may be affected, and with the dollar supported by U.S. rate‑hike expectations, the dual factors pressure the CAD.

Domestic Canadian economic data also gave little support to the CAD. August housing starts were 229,046 units annualized, below July’s revised 229,360 and below economists’ forecast of 240,000, indicating a slight cooling in residential construction activity.

Canadian government‑bond yields showed a flattening curve. The two‑year yield rose 2 basis points to 3.376%, while the ten‑year slipped 1.1 basis points to 3.941%, continuing the pull‑back after hitting near a three‑year high of 3.987% on Monday.

As the Canada‑U.S. rate differential again draws market attention, a stronger dollar also suppresses the CAD. After the Fed hike, the dollar index rose 0.3% on Wednesday to 99.961, a near‑five‑week high; the euro fell 0.3% to $1.1502, the pound slipped 0.5% to $1.34155, and the dollar rose 0.3% against the yen to ¥155.49.

The BoC’s policy rate remains clearly below the Fed’s, but if the U.S. continues hiking while the BoC holds rates steady, the Canada‑U.S. rate gap could widen further, becoming a key driver of the USD/CAD exchange rate. However, the BoC’s September policy statement also said it will keep assessing the sustainability of the economic recovery and the inflation outlook, and is ready to adjust policy if needed.
